PRIMING AS PROCESSING SKIPPED, NOT PROCESSING SPED UP. `A direct association forms between the stimulus presented and the response made to it. On a subsequent encounter with the stimulus, this association automatically cues the response, BYPASSING the various processing stages that were required to select that response during its first presentation.` That is a different claim from facilitation and from sharpening, and it makes a prediction neither does: change the response and the saving disappears

REPETITION SUPPRESSION IS NOT ONE THING, and this is the record that splits it: `a dissociation between RS within the PFC, which may be sensitive to retrieval of stimulus-response associations, and RS within posterior perceptual regions, which may reflect facilitation of perceptual pr[ocessing]`. Two regions, two mechanisms, one name. Gotts2012 reviews four candidate mechanisms as though the phenomenon were unitary; here it is divided by anatomy and each half takes a different explanation
THE artifact IS TIME-LOCKED TO THE BEHAVIOURAL VARIABLE OF INTEREST: lick-response-induced brain motion was the major obstacle, and licking happens at reward, which happens after the target
up to 15 micrometers of sinking as the animal opens its jaw, which a single plane would have recorded as an artifactual fluorescence change
THE CORRECTION DECIDES THE FINDING: standard two-dimensional correction removes the motion that is NOT lick-related, and only three-dimensional correction removes the motion that is

A CLASS ASSIGNED BY A PROXY FEATURE, CRITICISED BY NAME: the few studies that related behavioral modulation to cell type all inferred cellular identity from extracellular spike waveforms, WHICH HAS LIMITED SCOPE AND RELIABILITY
and the motivating problem is that the modulation of nearby neurons is heterogeneous IN MAGNITUDE AND EVEN IN DIRECTION, so a population average hides opposite effects
THE THRESHOLD IS NOT A PROPERTY OF THE ANIMAL ALONE: absolute orientation thresholds likely depend on the incidence of presentation of each stimulus, and on the task structure
and the ceiling of the discriminability measure is set by truncating the rates at 0.01 and 0.99, giving a maximum of 4.65 that belongs to the arithmetic and not to the mouse
THE DEMONSTRATION SESSION IS NOT THE TYPICAL SESSION, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO: the performance in the two imaging figures was below the trained level, in that mouse and even in that session
with about half the mice tested learning the task at all
THE SAMPLED POPULATION DEPENDS ON THE LABEL: the synthetic dye loads every cell in a local volume, while the genetically encoded indicator labels only a subset
A behaviorAL CONTROL THAT SHOWS THE ASSOCIATION IS NOT REFLEXIVE: mice stop licking when the spout is withdrawn, and the discrimination does not extinguish when it returns
and the same neurons give the same orientation preference during the behavior and during passive viewing, which is what licenses comparing the two

THE NEURAL INDEX IS A SEMANTIC-VIOLATION MARKER, WHICH IS A STRONGER CLAIM THAN A SLOWDOWN: a colour-modified fruit `should yield a SEMANTIC VIOLATION as indexed by an increase in N400 amplitude`, and it does. The behavioural half says the concept is harder to reach; the N400 says the modified image is treated as semantically WRONG for its category, which is what distinguishes an integral feature from a merely useful one
P2 and P2p are DIFFERENT components separated in time and space, despite names differing by one letter; P2p indexes the DE and P2 does not
anterior N1 and posterior N1 are different components with different generators; this study evokes the anterior one where the cited precedent evoked the posterior
SES is a composite score built from parental education, occupation and household resources by item response theory and principal components, not a single measured quantity

THE TITLE SAYS `IMPAIRS` AND THE RESULT IS A REVERSAL. `Participants in the UST group chose the faces that were shown 12 times significantly more, WHILE THOSE IN THE IMT GROUP WERE MORE LIKELY TO CHOOSE FACES PRESENTED ONCE.` Told the choice is unspecified, people pick what they have seen most; told it matters, they pick what they have seen LEAST. An instruction that inverts a preference is a stronger finding than one that removes it, and the abstract's verb understates the result
and the anatomy points away too: IN HUMANS, CORTICAL CIRCUITS UNDERLYING AUDITORY PERCEPTION AND COGNITION ARE LARGELY FOUND IN LATERAL, RATHER THAN MEDIAL TEMPORAL LOBE STRUCTURES

and the conclusion follows from the widening rather than from new data: IN LIGHT OF THIS EXTENDED PROPOSED FUNCTIONAL SCOPE, A FULL ACCOUNT OF THE AUDITORY SYSTEM SHOULD AT LEAST CONSIDER THE HIPPOCAMPUS

A DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN STUDIES ATTRIBUTED TO ONE PARAMETER OF THE ANALYSIS: DIFFERENCES ACROSS THE RESULTS OF THESE STUDIES MAY RELATE TO THE THRESHOLDS USED IN THE PROBABILISTIC TRACTOGRAPHY PROCEDURE

AND A DEFINITION IMPORTED FROM ANOTHER SENSE: AN AUDITORY PERCEPTUAL OBJECT, LIKE ITS VISUAL COUNTERPARTS, IS DEFINED BY THE BINDING OF MULTIPLE SENSORY FEATURES, REPRESENTS A SOURCE DISTINCT FROM OTHERS IN THE SCENE, AND IS INVARIANT OVER DIFFERENT SENSORY INSTANCES
A STRUCTURAL CORRELATION WHOSE CAUSAL READING IS WITHHELD: LONGITUDINAL STUDIES, SIMILAR TO THOSE IN TAXI DRIVERS, WILL BE IMPORTANT TO ESTABLISH CAUSALITY IN ANY OF THE ABOVE RELATIONSHIPS

and it does not generalize beyond experts: FOR SPATIAL NAVIGATION AND OTHER HIPPOCAMPUS-DEPENDENT TASKS, THE GENERALIZABILITY OF A VOLUME-FUNCTION RELATIONSHIP TO A NON-EXPERT POPULATION HAS NOT BEEN DEMONSTRATED

THE FINDING CITED FOR A STRUCTURE WAS MEASURED IN A DIFFERENT ONE, AND THE REVIEW SAYS SO IN A PARENTHESIS: THE VOLUME OF PARAHIPPOCAMPAL GYRUS (HIPPOCAMPUS WAS NOT TESTED) WAS FOUND TO CORRELATE POSITIVELY WITH AN INDEX OF MUSICAL SOPHISTICATION IN A GROUP OF 73 OLDER ADULTS AFTER CONTROLLING FOR INTRACRANIAL VOLUME
and the positive associations that do exist are with training time: POSITIVE RELATIONSHIPS BETWEEN YEARS OF TRAINING AND ANTERIOR HIPPOCAMPAL GRAY MATTER VOLUME IN MUSICIANS AND PIANO-TUNERS

A CLINICAL EFFECT THAT DEPENDS ON THE TIMING AND NOT THE SOUND: CLICK TRAINS PRESENTED AT THIS RATE (BUT NOT WITH RANDOM TIMING) REDUCED SIGNS OF ALZHEIMER'S PATHOLOGY (AMYLOID LOAD AND TAU PHOSPHORYLATION) IN THE HIPPOCAMPUS OF THIS MOUSE MODEL AND BOOSTED MEMORY FOR THE IDENTITY AND LOCATION OF OBJECTS
A CONFOUND REMOVED BY MOVING THE RESPONSE: BY HAVING SUBJECTS REPORT TARGET COUNTS AT THE END OF A TRIAL OR BLOCK, EXPLICIT MOTOR CONFOUNDS ARE REMOVED

and the review names what is still not known: IT REMAINS TO BE DETERMINED WHETHER SOUNDS PREDICTED ON THE BASIS OF ASSOCIATIONS LEARNED IN THE SHORT-TERM OR THROUGH SEMANTIC CONTEXT CAN BE DECODED FROM HIPPOCAMPAL ACTIVITY BEFORE THEY ARE HEARD
AN APPARENTLY MULTISENSORY SIGNAL EXPLAINED AWAY BY behavior: neural activity that is apparently multisensory MAY SIMPLY ARISE from low-dimensional signals associated with internal state and behavior
THE HYPOTHESIS IS TURNED INTO FOUR ADVANCE PREDICTIONS: low dimension, a broad footprint beyond the cortex, independence from auditory input, and predictability from behavior

THE MANIPULATION WAS CHOSEN FOR WHAT IT DOES NOT DISTURB: silencing or stimulating auditory cortex would interfere with auditory processing and could affect the sound-evoked behavior, so the fibres were cut instead

THREE METHOD DIFFERENCES ENUMERATED WHERE THE RESULT CONTRADICTS THE STUDY THAT INTRODUCED THE SAME CUT: intracellular in layers 2/3 against extracellular in layers 4-6, hours against days after surgery, and anesthetized against awake
AND A THRESHOLD AGAINST A FRACTION: the earlier whisking study used a hard threshold to call a response auditory or movement-related, where this one estimated the fraction explained
THE DIMENSIONALITY OF THE RESPONSE IS USED TO CLASSIFY WHAT KIND OF SIGNAL IT IS: four significant components for sounds against seventy-nine for videos, and zero for their interaction
A SELECTION STEP CHECKED AGAINST THE RESULT IT COULD HAVE PRODUCED: the reliability of auditory responses did not correlate with the spike-contamination score, and if anything went the other way

A WHOLE LITERATURE'S CONTROLS DECLARED INADEQUATE: distinguishing auditory signals from state and behavior requires careful and systematic controls, WHICH ARE RARELY PERFORMED in passively listening mice
AND THE AUTHORS RE-RAN IT: the reported statistic was replaced with a paired Wilcoxon sign-rank test on the same data, and the conclusion survived
SAMPLE SIZE DECIDED WHAT EXISTED: earlier work found no feedback effect in central IC; recording more neurons revealed a subset there
AN ASYMMETRY BETWEEN DRIVING AND SILENCING is the paper's central result, and it is read as a claim about the resting state rather than as a failed manipulation
MORE FIRING, LESS TUNING: the feedback is described as reducing selectivity rather than sharpening it, against the expectation the earlier stimulation literature set
THE SAME RESULT SAID PLAINLY, in the authors' own restatement
AN EFFECT SMALLER THAN EXPECTED IS REPORTED AS SUCH, and read as evidence that the target population inside IC is small
A NEGATIVE RESULT ABOUT INHIBITION: changes made by PV interneurons in cortex do not reach the colliculus
THE FIELD'S DEFAULT IS ASCENDING: descending feedback is described as routinely overlooked
A ROBUSTNESS CHECK AGAINST A SELECTION ARTEFACT: the DCIC result is re-run on rate-matched units in case a few high-firing units carried it
TWO MECHANISMS FOR ONE OBSERVATION ARE LEFT OPEN: direct activation and disinhibition are not equivalent, which is offered as why the interneuron result differs
the analysed effect sample is conditioned on the dependent variable: respondents answering No to having experienced any change were sent straight to the end of the survey
improvement is a single retrospective cursor position from -100 to +100, not a repeated clinical measure, and the OCI-r was collected only at survey time

A DEFINING CRITERION THAT SURVIVED ITS OWN REFUTATION: the pre-categorical nature is one of the three characteristics that define iconic memory, and evidence has since shown the system is NOT entirely pre-categorical

A CAPACITY THAT WAS NEVER OBSERVED, ONLY EXTRAPOLATED: subjects recalled three or four letters in the full report and about 75% of a cued row, and the large capacity follows by EXTRAPOLATING the partial report to the total

THE CLASS IS characterizeD BY ITS BEST-STUDIED MEMBER: research focused on iconic memory, the other two sensory types are comparatively scarce, and iconic memory is therefore presented as the paradigm of the class
ONE REFERENT, TWO NAMES, WRITTEN AS A PARENTHESIS: declarative memory (explicit) and non-declarative memory (implicit/procedural)
A DISTINCTION RENAMED ACROSS A CENTURY: James in 1890 distinguished primary from secondary memory, THEREBY REFERRING TO short- and long-term memory

THE FIELD'S FIRST RESPONSE TO A FALSIFYING CASE WAS TO QUARANTINE IT: the patient learned a skill without remembering the task, and discussions at the time SET ASIDE motor skills as a special case, keeping the rest of memory of one piece
A GLOSSARY THAT DISCLAIMS ITSELF: the commentary is NOT INTENDED AS AN EXHAUSTIVE DEFINITION, only enough to situate the reader in a complex panorama
A DOUBLE DISSOCIATION BORROWED FROM TWO GENETIC SYNDROMES: Williams patients keep language and Down patients keep more spatial capacity, and each does better on the matching task
ONE EVENT LAID DOWN TWICE: the same childhood accident consolidates as a declarative memory of the event and crystallises separately as a phobia
with the gap named exactly: in ALMOST ALL previous studies comparing anesthetized and awake states, ONLY THE LEMNISCAL IC CORE WAS INVESTIGATED

THE STANDARD STATISTIC DOES NOT EXIST FOR THIS DATA TYPE, AND THE RESULT IS DOWNGRADED ACCORDINGLY: Rayleigh statistics and vector strength are NOT APPLICABLE to calcium imaging, so the temporal differences are SUGGESTIVE BUT SHOULD NOT BE TAKEN AS CONCLUSIVE EVIDENCE
AN ANATOMICAL LABEL THAT CANNOT BE VERIFIED: no reliable histological proof could differentiate the two candidate subregions, so the site is reported as what they were PROBABLY recording from

TWO PUBLISHED MECHANISMS FOR THE SAME EFFECT, IN CONTRADICTION, AND THE PAPER MARKS IT: one group reports disinhibition through VIP and somatostatin cells, another found ALL inhibitory and excitatory neurons excited, CHALLENGING THE DISINHIBITION MODEL
AND THE SIGN OF THE SAME MANIPULATION DEPENDS ON THE MODALITY: locomotion DECREASES response gains in auditory cortex and INCREASES them in visual cortex
THE POPULATION RESULT HIDES A QUARTER GOING THE OTHER WAY: locomotion narrows the spectral bandwidth overall, and 48% of excitatory neurons increased selectivity while 24% DECREASED it
AND GAIN AND SELECTIVITY COME APART: locomotion does NOT affect the response gain of either cell type, while selectivity of excitatory neurons is significantly increased
THE CELL-TYPE RULE IS OPPOSITE TO THE ONE IN CORTEX: in cortex the excitatory neurons are the selective ones, and here the INHIBITORY neurons have the narrower spectral bandwidth in both states
with the selectivity proposed to be INHERITED from ascending brainstem input rather than computed locally

THE PAPER SHIPS ITS OWN GLOSSARY, AND THE FIRST ENTRY LEAVES A PROPERTY UNDETERMINED: a cell assembly is a group of neurons that transiently co-activate, and RECIPROCAL CONNECTIVITY BETWEEN GROUP MEMBERS MAY OR MAY NOT BE IMPLIED

the definition of phase precession is extended past its original object: initially described in place cells, it has also been reported in interneurons, episode and sound-responsive cells, IN WHICH CASE THE MOVEMENT IS CONSIDERED IN A MORE ABSTRACT SPACE

A DISAGREEMENT BETWEEN TWO OTHER PAPERS, WITH THE PARAMETER IT TURNS ON, STATED BY A THIRD: the apparent inconsistency with the results of one study MAY STEM FROM THE LIMITED NUMBER OF REPLAY EVENTS EXAMINED in the other

THE DATA CANNOT SEPARATE THE THEORIES, SAID PLAINLY: the same studies support the interference models and also report the critical prediction of the rival models, and because a third class can account for the same findings IT BECOMES UNCLEAR WHETHER INTRACELLULAR DATA DO DISCRIMINATE between different classes of models

A REINTERPRETATION THAT REMOVES EVIDENCE FROM A HYPOTHESIS WITHOUT NEW DATA: the independent coding model IS SUFFICIENT TO REPLICATE THE DATA PREVIOUSLY INTERPRETED AS EVIDENCE FOR THE COORDINATED ASSEMBLY HYPOTHESIS

ONE FINDING UNDERMINING A WHOLE FRAMEWORK: a novel form of synaptic potentiation at the behavioral timescale could store entire sequences of events seconds before and after, which EFFECTIVELY UNDERMINES THE THEORETICAL FRAMEWORK that theta sequences are REQUIRED to bring spike trains into temporal proximity

THREE CAUSAL STUDIES, THREE CONFOUNDS SUPPLIED BY THE REVIEWERS RATHER THAN BY THE ORIGINAL AUTHORS. First: the drug that impaired the task also DECREASES RIPPLE POWER, so the deficit could come from altered activity during awake ripples instead
second: one cannot entirely rule out that the deficits were DIRECTLY DUE TO DISRUPTION OF THETA OSCILLATIONS, given an 80% decrease in theta power

with the size of the evidence base stated: ONLY THREE STUDIES have reported task performance deficits linked to a degradation of theta sequences, because interfering with theta sequences is challenging

A WHOLE TECHNIQUE CRITICISED ON TIMING GROUNDS: tagging studies ARTIFICIALLY ACTIVATE NEURONS IN A HYPER-SYNCHRONOUS MANNER and NEGLECT ANY FINE-TIMESCALE TEMPORAL INFORMATION, and because the labeling window RANGES FROM SEVERAL HOURS TO DAYS the tagged population is likely to include numerous irrelevant neurons

A NUMBER THAT LOOKS LIKE 360 DEGREES ONLY BECAUSE OF POOLING: the range may APPEAR TO SPAN AS MUCH AS 360 degrees WHEN POOLING DATA OVER MULTIPLE FIELD CROSSINGS, while single-trial phase range is typically about 180 and NEVER EXCEEDS A FULL CYCLE
and then past space altogether: phase precession MAY NOT BE UNIQUELY LINKED TO SPACE, but rather to the full episodic component of the ongoing experience

and a prediction credited in a footnote, retrospectively: in its UNCORRECTED version, this model PREDICTED THAT PLACE CELLS SHOULD FIRE IN REGULAR SPATIAL PATTERNS LONG BEFORE THE DISCOVERY OF GRID CELLS

THE CONCLUSION KEEPS THE QUESTION OPEN: a notable fraction of theta cycles CONTAIN NON-CANONICAL ACTIVITY, INCLUDING SEEMINGLY RANDOM NOISE AND EVEN REVERSE SEQUENCES, and IT REMAINS CURRENTLY UNCLEAR WHICH SPECIFIC FUNCTIONS ARE SUSTAINED BY THETA SEQUENCES, AWAKE REPLAY, OR BOTH

THE GAP BETWEEN A CORRELATE AND A ROLE, STATED IN THE FIRST SENTENCE: NUMEROUS BRAIN REGIONS HAVE BEEN SHOWN TO HAVE NEURAL CORRELATES OF GRADUALLY ACCUMULATING EVIDENCE FOR DECISION-MAKING, BUT THE CAUSAL ROLES OF THESE REGIONS IN DECISIONS DRIVEN BY ACCUMULATION OF EVIDENCE HAVE YET TO BE DETERMINED

AND THE TEST RETURNS NULL WHERE THE CORRELATE IS STRONGEST, WITH THE AUTHORS' REACTION IN THE TEXT: GIVEN THE VIEW THAT THE PPC PLAYS A KEY CAUSAL ROLE IN RODENT PERCEPTUAL DECISIONS AND THAT NEURAL ACTIVITY IN PPC DISPLAYS CORRELATES OF ACCUMULATING AUDITORY EVIDENCE, WE WERE SURPRISED TO FIND THAT UNILATERAL INACTIVATION OF THE PPC DID NOT CAUSE A SIDE BIAS

and the obvious escape route is closed by experiment, not by argument: COMPENSATION FROM THE UNPERTURBED HEMISPHERE DID NOT EXPLAIN THE LACK OF AN EFFECT, BECAUSE BILATERAL INACTIVATION OF THE PPC CAUSED A MINIMAL DECREASE IN PERFORMANCE (3.6%) THAT WAS NOT SIGNIFICANTLY DIFFERENT FROM UNILATERAL INACTIVATIONS
and the conclusion about both regions is itself a negative: NEITHER REGION APPEARS LIKELY TO PLAY A MAJOR CAUSAL ROLE IN THE GRADUAL EVIDENCE ACCUMULATION PROCESS PER SE
with the scope of the positive claim bounded in the next clause: DECISIONS WITH SHORTER PROCESSING TIMES MAY INVOLVE CIRCUITS THAT BYPASS THE FOF

and the positive result agrees with a 2000 microstimulation study while going further: OUR RESULTS IN RAT FOF ARE CONSISTENT WITH THOSE OF GOLD AND SHADLEN, BUT GO CONSIDERABLY FURTHER IN SPECIFICALLY SUGGESTING THE FOF AS A REQUISITE PREMOTOR COMPONENT OF THE OUTPUT PATHWAY OF A LONG TIME CONSTANT (>0.24 s) EVIDENCE ACCUMULATOR
A SPECIFICITY ARGUMENT MADE FROM WHAT THE NEIGHBOUR DOES: THE EFFECTS OBSERVED ARE MORE LIKELY DUE TO CHANGES IN FOF RATHER THAN AN ADJACENT CORTICAL REGION

EVERY EXISTING CRITERION HAD FAILED, AND THE PAPER LISTS THEM. Morphology: BOTH DISC-SHAPED AND STELLATE CELLS CAN BE GLUTAMATERGIC OR GABAERGIC, AN INDICATION THAT EACH OF THESE MORPHOLOGICAL GROUPS CONSISTS OF AT LEAST TWO NEURON TYPES

Tone responses: A COMPREHENSIVE STUDY SHOWED THAT THESE RESPONSES FORM A CONTINUUM AND CANNOT BE USED ON THEIR OWN TO DEFINE FUNCTIONALLY SIGNIFICANT GROUPS OF NEURONS. A category defeated by a measured continuum, not by disagreement

THE CLASS IS SEPARABLE AND INTERNALLY VARIABLE AT THE SAME TIME: ALTHOUGH STATISTICALLY DIFFERENT FROM THE GENERAL NEURONAL POPULATION IN THE IC AND SHOWING A TIGHTLY CLUSTERED SFA RATIO, THE INTRINSIC PHYSIOLOGY OF VIP NEURONS STILL SHOWED SOME LEVEL OF VARIABILITY

A LUMPING DECISION JUSTIFIED BY A NULL: RECORDINGS MADE FROM THE ICc, ICd, AND IClc WERE LUMPED TOGETHER FOR THIS EXPERIMENT BECAUSE THERE WERE NO CLEAR DIFFERENCES IN VIP NEURON PHYSIOLOGY ACROSS THESE SUBDIVISIONS OF THE IC. The pooling is declared and its reason is an absence
and the residual spread was followed rather than left as noise: WE THEREFORE HYPOTHESIZED THAT THE INTRINSIC PHYSIOLOGY OF VIP NEURONS IN THE ICc VARIED ALONG THE TONOTOPIC AXIS OF THE ICc
THE CLASS IS SMALL: VIP NEURONS REPRESENT 2.3% OF THE TOTAL POPULATION OF NEURONS IN THE MOUSE IC (208 OF 9304 NEURONS)
and the spininess that helps mark the class is not exclusive to it: DENDRITIC SPINES CAN BE PRESENT ON A VARIETY OF CELL TYPES, INCLUDING STELLATE AND DISC-SHAPED CELLS

THE TASK IS COPIED SO THAT THE RESULTS CAN BE COMPARED: using the identical task is what allows a direct comparison, because even small changes in task parameters may introduce substantial differences in neuronal responses and lead to different conclusions

AND THE WORKED EXAMPLE IS IN THE SAME PARAGRAPH: in a similar task, one study found nearly no color information in monkey prefrontal cortex where another found it, so the exact task design may determine what the neurons appear to encode

A MODEL'S SCOPE IS TESTED BY MOVING IT OFF THE SUBSTRATE IT WAS BUILT ON: the model rests solely on monkey electrophysiology and is thus implicitly tied to the layered columns of the neocortex, and it fits a non-layered avian area too

ONE COMPUTATION, TWO OPPOSITE OUTCOMES, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO: the same normalization that destroys information in one subpopulation creates it in another, which may appear counter-intuitive and contradictory
THE CRITERION DETERMINES THE POPULATION FOUND: more than half the significant delay neurons were significant only at load 2 or load 3, so testing at load 1 alone would have missed them
and the neurons that gain information at higher load were found only because the selection was widened, not because they were predicted

THE DATA FIT BOTH RIVAL FAMILIES IN DIFFERENT RESPECTS: graded within-hemifield allocation fits a continuous resource, hemispheric independence fits discrete slots, and a nuanced slots-and-averaging model accommodates both

SHARED COMPUTATION ACROSS UNSHARED ARCHITECTURE IS THE POINT: differently organised areas produce strikingly similar physiological responses, which is read as convergent evolution onto the same basic mechanisms and the same limits

and the second: where load was varied, THE AUDITORY STIMULI ALWAYS CO-VARIED WITH THE WM LOAD ACROSS CONDITIONS, so the differences COULD REFLECT DIFFERENCES IN ACTIVITY EVOKED BY DIFFERENT STIMULI RATHER THAN DIFFERENCES IN WM LOAD
and the question is left open in the introduction rather than assumed: THUS, IT IS STILL AN OPEN QUESTION WHETHER AC EXHIBITS PERSISTENT CHANGES IN NEURAL ACTIVITY RELATED TO AUDITORY WM

A RESULT THAT AGREES WITH ONE LITERATURE AND CONTRADICTS ANOTHER, ACROSS SPECIES AND METHOD: the WM-related activity WAS STIMULUS SPECIFIC, which CONFIRMS the stimulus-specificity revealed in fMRI STUDIES OF HUMANS BUT CONTRASTS WITH STUDIES OF NONHUMAN PRIMATES WHICH REPORTED STIMULUS-SPECIFICITY TO BE MISSING
and the limit on that very claim, in the next sentence: SINCE ONLY TWO TONES (1 AND 3 kHz) WERE TESTED, THE STIMULUS SELECTIVITY COULD NOT BE ASSESSED ACCURATELY

THE TIMING RUNS THE WRONG WAY FOR THE STANDARD STORY: differential latencies were SIGNIFICANTLY SHORTER IN CORE FIELDS OF AC THAN IN vlPFC, by about 100 ms, which IS DIFFICULT TO RECONCILE WITH THE NOTION THAT PFC EXERTS A TOP-DOWN MODULATION of activity in sensory cortex
and what was not looked at is listed: information could also be stored in SPATIOTEMPORAL ACTIVATION PATTERNS, SYNAPTIC PLASTICITY, OR RHYTHMIC ACTIVITIES, BUT THESE WERE NOT ANALYZED HERE
with the spatial reach of the measurement limiting the anatomical claim: WE CANNOT CLARIFY WHETHER OTHER FIELDS OF AC ARE ALSO INVOLVED, because the slow potentials CAN SPREAD OVER MILLIMETERS

and the hypothesis it supports is one whose existing evidence base the paper describes as indirect: the sensory-recruitment hypothesis HAS MAINLY BEEN BASED ON MULTIVARIATE ANALYSIS OF fMRI SIGNAL PATTERNS, thus ON A SIGNAL THAT IS ONLY INDIRECTLY RELATED TO BRAIN ACTIVITY, BUT NOT ON DIRECT MEASUREMENTS of electric activity in sensory cortex

and a rival hypothesis is left compatible rather than defeated: the results are ALSO COMPATIBLE WITH THE STATIC POPULATION CODING HYPOTHESIS, because WM-related activity was also seen IN NEURONS THAT DID NOT RESPOND TO THE TWO TONES

and so is the word TASK, which most papers leave undefined: an operation requiring the production of AN INTENTIONAL CONNECTION BETWEEN SOUNDS, OTHER CONTEXT-RELEVANT STIMULI, AND BEHAVIORAL ACTIONS, WHICH ARE EXECUTED BECAUSE SUBJECTS ARE MOTIVATED TO DO SO
with the scope of the conclusion bounded at the end: whether persistent activity changes ALSO SUPPORT STORAGE FOR EVEN LONGER PERIODS and other WM processes IS NOT CLEAR AND IS UNDER DEBATE

the two accounts of repetition priming, set out as alternatives: FACILITATION OF COMPONENT PROCESSES (repetition tunes the pathway that produces the response) against DIRECT STIMULUS-RESPONSE BINDING retrieved from episodic memory (instance theory, event file theory, action-trigger theory). The difference is whether anything is STORED about the pairing, or whether the machinery simply runs better the second time

the same task across species is an EQUIVALENCE CLAIM resting on declared adjustments: reward volume scaled to each species' normal consumption, tubing gauge changed, sound levels set above each species' own threshold
subjective category boundary is the 50% point of a fitted logistic, distinct from the experimenter's boundary, and it is what shifts between blocks
speed of switching is measured as the trial at which an exponential fit crosses chance, not as trials to criterion
valid trials exclude early withdrawals, so every performance figure is conditioned on the animal having waited out the sound

NON-UNIQUENESS IS DECLARED IN THE METHODS, BEFORE ANY RESULT: with many interacting parameters, alternative sets could reproduce similar results, and no model can be shown to provide a unique solution
which is only visible because the alternatives were built and reported rather than assumed away

TWO RESULTS FROM ONE MODEL WITH DIFFERENT EVIDENTIAL STATUS, AND THE PAPER GRADES THEM: for the hemispheric difference the parameter space was narrowed after the fact, and for the contralateral difference there were clear prior hypotheses predicting the parameters AND the direction, enabling much clearer conclusions
and the contralateral model changed only four parameters, chosen from the literature rather than from the data, against 28 hand-tuned and optimized for the other
with the hemispheric interpretation labelled model-derived predictions, because there were no clear pre-defined hypotheses

THE FITTED PARAMETER MAY BE ABSORBING AN ANATOMICAL artifact: cortical folding in the left hemisphere increases signal cancelation, so the parameter differences may be compensating for structure rather than reflecting function
A QUANTITY THAT WAS NOT FITTED IS USED AS VALIDATION: firing rates were not part of the fitting procedure and land within physiological ranges, which is offered as further support

THE SAME TEST ON SIMULATED AND ON RECORDED DATA IS NOT THE SAME OBJECT: the reduced variability of simulations means the statistics are not directly comparable, and they are reported anyway for the qualitative features
and the simulations are smoothed specifically so that a comparison can be made at all, a transform applied to one side of it
A NON-SIGNIFICANT TREND BECOMES A MODELLED MECHANISM: latency differences did not reach significance, and a 5 ms shift was put into the model and captured the trend well

THE CANONICAL ASSUMPTION IS GRANTED WITH ITS EXCEPTION STATED: auditory connectivity is less well understood, laminar differences are less prominent than in visual or somatosensory cortex, and layer IV may play a different role
SUSTAINED ACTIVITY IS NOT WORKING MEMORY: a region can hold information in subthreshold patterns without elevated activity, and elevated activity can reflect sustained attention instead
the classifier sees only the middle 10.5 s of the delay, with 4 s trimmed at each end, because the probe tone belonged to the same category and could otherwise leak into the decoding
connectivity is never compared with rest, because heart rate and other physiological variables differ between task and rest and are known to confound functional connectivity

the inclusion criteria differ BY ANALYSIS and each difference is justified: poor performers are excluded from classification to reduce noise and retained in the univariate analysis because the brain-behaviour correlation requires the spread

d-PRIME is d', the signal-detection sensitivity index, and not a priming prime despite carrying the word: it is the per-subject detection measure (0.89, 0.99, 1.16) used as the exclusion criterion for the pattern analysis

THE HEADLINE MECHANISM IS DECLARED UNTESTED, IN THE PAPER'S OWN DISCUSSION: ALTHOUGH THE CAUSALITY OR EVEN THE CONTRIBUTION OF THE PROPOSED ROLES OF PVs, SOMs, AND VIPs AND RECOVERED A1 SOUND PROCESSING WERE NOT TESTED HERE, THEY WILL BE EVALUATED IN FUTURE WORK

and a third time, inside the sentence that states the conclusion: OUR OBSERVATIONS ARE CONSISTENT WITH THE NOTION, ALBEIT NOT TESTED HERE, THAT PVs ACT AS THE STABILIZERS, WHEREAS SOMs ACT AS THE MODULATORS OF A1 PLASTICITY. Three declarations of the same limit, in three places, on the claim the title carries

and the regime that makes the model's conclusions follow is an assumption whose truth is open: THE ASSUMPTION THAT CORTICAL INHIBITION IS NEEDED TO PREVENT PATHOLOGIC ACTIVITY PLACES THE MODEL IN THE ISN (ISN) REGIME, and IT REMAINS AN OPEN QUESTION WHETHER THE CORTEX LIES IN THE ISN REGIME WITH INHIBITION ACTIVELY PREVENTING UNSTABLE DYNAMICS BY BALANCING EXCITATION OR IS SIMPLY WIRED TO RESIST INSTABILITY

TWO IMAGING METHODS, SAME RULE, DIFFERENT SIZE: WIDE-FIELD IMAGING SHOWED LARGER SHIFTS AND REDUCED RECOVERY IN THE RESPONSE THRESHOLDS COMPARED TO THE 2P IMAGING, because WIDE-FIELD IMAGING ASSESSES RESPONSES FROM DIFFERENT NEURONAL COMPARTMENTS (SOMATA AND DENDRITES) AND DIFFERENT CORTICAL LAYERS

WHAT RECOVERS IS NOT WHAT MATTERS: COMPENSATORY A1 PLASTICITY LIKELY SUPPORTS THE RECOVERY OF THE PERCEPTUAL SOUND-DETECTION THRESHOLD BUT DOES NOT SUPPORT SOUND PROCESSING ENCODED BY PRECISE SPIKE TIMING, SUCH AS MODULATED NOISE OR SPEECH, AND RESTRICTS HEARING IN A NOISY ENVIRONMENT

THE IDENTITY OF WHAT WAS MEASURED IS LEFT OPEN: WHILE WE DO NOT EXCLUDE THE POSSIBILITY OF IMAGING INTO THE CENTRAL NUCLEUS OF THE IC, WE BELIEVE THE OBSERVED TONOTOPY TO BE A GOOD REPRESENTATION OF THE IC SHELL REGION

TWO CLASSES OF RESPONSE EXIST BECAUSE THE ANIMAL WAS AWAKE AND THE TONE WAS LONG: INHIBITORY AND OFFSET RESPONSES WERE NOT REPORTED IN EARLIER IMAGING EXPERIMENTS PERFORMED IN ANESTHETIZED MICE, and THEIR USE OF SHORTER STIMULI DID NOT ALLOW A DISTINCTION BETWEEN ONSET AND SUSTAINED RESPONSES. Two conditions, two whole response categories

and the size of that difference is stated against a named earlier number: THE PROPORTION OF CELLS SHOWING SOUND-EVOKED INHIBITION WAS CLEARLY HIGHER THAN THE 2-23% REPORTED FOR ANESTHETIZED C57BL/6 MICE

THE SAME MEASUREMENT MADE IN A neighborING STRUCTURE GIVES THE OPPOSITE ANSWER: OUR RESULTS THUS DIFFER FROM AUDITORY CORTEX, WHERE LOCAL MICROHETEROGENEITY IS MUCH SMALLER FOR (PARVALBUMIN-POSITIVE) GABAERGIC NEURONS THAN FOR GLUTAMATERGIC NEURONS, and here THE MICROHETEROGENEITY WAS SIMILAR FOR GABAERGIC AND GLUTAMATERGIC NEURONS

and one candidate cause of a disagreement is the indicator, not the tissue: THIS MICROHETEROGENEITY WAS LARGER THAN IN AN EARLIER STUDY IN WHICH BULK LOADING OF AN ORGANIC Ca INDICATOR WAS USED, WHICH MAY HAVE MADE IT MORE DIFFICULT TO ISOLATE RESPONSES FROM INDIVIDUAL CELLS

THE COUNT THAT SURVIVES TWO EXCLUSIONS IS THE ONE REPORTED: 165 (OUT OF 1359) CELLS SHOWED A POSITIVE CORRELATION WITH FACIAL MOVEMENTS, and IN THE END, 41 CELLS SHOWED SPONTANEOUS CALCIUM TRANSIENTS THAT CORRELATED WITH ANIMAL MOVEMENT AND THAT COULD NOT BE EXPLAINED BY THEIR FRA

A NEGATIVE THAT DOES THE ARGUMENTATIVE WORK: MOVEMENT-SENSITIVE NEURONS WERE NOT FOUND IN THE HIGH-FREQUENCY DCIC REGIONS, BUT ONLY IN THE PUTATIVE CNIC REGION AND THE LCIC. The border is drawn by where the cells are ABSENT

and the detection method could not have found the effect the literature predicts: FOR SOMATOSENSORY INPUTS, THE DOMINANT EFFECT APPEARS TO BE INHIBITORY, WHICH WOULD NOT HELP DETECTION BASED ON OUR SELECTION CRITERIA

AN EVIDENTIAL STATUS STATED IN THE TEXT: WE OBTAINED ANECDOTAL EVIDENCE THAT NEURONS AT THE BORDER OF THE MODULES CAN EXTEND DENDRITES INTO THE MODULES. The mechanism that answers the paper's own open question is offered as anecdote, in the authors' own word

the same asymmetry in the other line: GAD67 IMMUNOREACTIVITY was detected IN >93% OF GCaMP-POSITIVE NEURONS IN THE Gad2;Ai96 MICE, and NOT ALL GAD67-POSITIVE CELLS IN THIS MOUSE LINE WERE LABELED BY GCaMP6s
A MARKER THAT DOES NOT PLACE A CELL: AT THE SINGLE NEURON LEVEL, THE PRESENCE OR ABSENCE OF THE TWO BUFFERS WAS INSUFFICIENT TO INDICATE WHETHER THE NEURONS LAY WITHIN A MODULE

the difference between the two cell classes is one measurement and it is a size: GABAERGIC CELLS HAD A LARGER SOMA SIZE, AS REPORTED PREVIOUSLY, and WITHIN EACH GENOTYPE, SOMA SIZE DID NOT DIFFER SIGNIFICANTLY AMONG CELLS WITH DIFFERENT FRA CLASSES
and the conclusion is stated as a definition rather than a discovery: OUR EXPERIMENTS THUS PROVIDE A FUNCTIONAL DEFINITION OF THE MAJOR ORGANIZATION PRINCIPLES OF THE DORSAL IC IN ADULT MICE

A PREDICTION IS STATED AS A CONDITIONAL AND THEN FALSIFIED BY THE AUTHORS' OWN EXPERIMENT: if the pathway specifically carries noise, then inactivation would block the noise-trained response BUT NOT the tone-trained one
TWO DISAGREEMENTS WITH THE LITERATURE, EACH ATTRIBUTED TO A DIFFERENT METHODOLOGICAL PARAMETER: one to the drug, since lidocaine lasts 10-15 minutes and muscimol more than an hour

THE DRUG WAS CHOSEN FOR ITS HALF-LIFE, before the disagreement arose: muscimol lasts long enough for the long-lasting training, which is the same property later used to explain the other laboratory's null
THE INSTRUMENT DECIDES THE SIGN OF THE FINDING: whole-cell recording shows hyperpolarization to a tone, extracellular recording shows spikes, and the data from the two APPEAR DIFFERENT
A DISSOCIATION BETWEEN LEARNING AND REMEMBERING: during acquisition every group froze alike with no differences among them, and a day later the inactivated groups had nothing
A CONNECTIVITY CLAIM INFERRED FROM A RANK ORDER OF MEANS: 15.7 ms before 19-21 ms before 24.6 ms, which is read as the direction the information travels
AND THE PAPER SEPARATES TWO THINGS THAT ARE USUALLY RUN TOGETHER: that responses to a conditioned sound are enhanced by training DOES NOT MEAN the neurons respond to that sound
and the conditioned response generalizes completely across frequency, so a mouse trained on one tone freezes to all of them

THE CATEGORY DOES NOT CARVE, AND THE REVIEW SAYS SO IN ITS OWN VOICE: THESE APPROACHES TYPICALLY PRODUCE PARTIALLY OVERLAPPING CATEGORIES, PRODUCING AN INEVITABLE TENSION BETWEEN THE TENDENCY TO BE A “LUMPER” OR A “SPLITTER.”

AND THE UNCERTAINTY IS QUANTIFIED RATHER THAN HEDGED: THE TRUE NUMBER OF DISTINCT SUBTYPES OF SOM CELLS IS UNKNOWN, and it MOST LIKELY LIES SOMEWHERE BETWEEN 4 AND 100 SUBTYPES. A twenty-five-fold range on how many kinds of thing the name refers to, printed as the review's own estimate

the upper bound is a count of what has NOT BEEN RULED OUT, not of what has been seen: THESE ASSUMPTIONS ARE POORLY CONSTRAINED BY DATA BECAUSE MOST STUDIES HAVE MEASURED ONLY A SUBSET OF THESE CRITERIA, and ADDITIONAL DATA THAT FURTHER CONSTRAINS THE NUMBER OF POSSIBLE COMBINATIONS WOULD REDUCE THIS NUMBER

ONE CRITERION CANNOT IDENTIFY THE CLASS: SOM-POSITIVE CELLS CAN ALSO EXHIBIT TONIC FAST SPIKING FIRING PROPERTIES AND PV-POSITIVE NEURONS CAN BE STUTTERING FAST SPIKING, WHICH INDICATES THAT DIFFERENT CELLS TYPES CAN HAVE SIMILAR FIRING PROPERTIES AND THUS THIS CRITERION ALONE CAN NOT BE USED TO RELIABLY IDENTIFY A SPECIFIC CELL TYPE

A DISTINCTION THAT EXISTS IN THE TOOL AND NOT IN THE TISSUE: L4 SOM CELLS MAY BE A SINGLE POPULATION, WITH NO APPARENT FUNCTIONAL CORRELATES OF THEIR SEGREGATION INTO X94 AND NON-X94 CATEGORIES. The line drew the boundary; nothing measured since has found anything on either side of it

and the disagreement may be nothing but vocabulary: DIFFERENT STUDIES HAVE ADOPTED DIFFERENT TERMINOLOGY (EITHER BURSTING OR LTS), AND REPORT SOMEWHAT DIFFERENT LAMINAR DISTRIBUTIONS, WHICH IS FURTHER COMPLICATED BY THE FACT THAT SOME STUDIES ARE IN RAT WHILE OTHERS ARE IN MOUSE

THE CATEGORIES ARE NOT EVEN THE SAME ACROSS SPECIES: IN RATS PV, SOM, AND CALRETININ (CR) CELLS FORM NON-OVERLAPPING CATEGORIES, WHEREAS MICE SHOW OVERLAPPING EXPRESSION OF SOM AND CR. The same three names partition one animal and not the other

the same one-way shape, denied in both directions for the other class: NOT ALL PV CELLS ARE FS CELLS, AND NOT ALL FS CELLS ARE PV CELLS. A molecular name and a physiological name that are used interchangeably and are not the same set
THE TOOL THAT MAKES THE CLASS VISIBLE LEAKS INTO THE CLASS IT IS DEFINED AGAINST: AT LEAST ONE SOM-CRE LINE ALSO ERRONEOUSLY MARKS A SMALL SUBSET (6-10%) OF FAST SPIKING PV NEURONS
and the census is biased by the same tool: BECAUSE THEY LABEL ONLY SUBSETS OF SOM CELLS, ONE MUST BE CAREFUL NOT TO INFER RELATIVE PROPORTIONS OF SOM SUBTYPES FROM STUDIES USING THESE LINES

THE PROPERTY BELONGS TO THE INTERACTION, NOT TO THE CELL TYPE: WHETHER GAIN CONTROL IS DIVISIVE OR SUBTRACTIVE IS DYNAMIC AND STIMULUS-DEPENDENT, RATHER THAN A FIXED PROPERTY OF A GIVEN CELL TYPE. Every tag of the form `SOM provides subtractive inhibition` is therefore true only of a condition, and the condition is not in the tag

and it may not belong to the interneuron at all: THESE FORMS OF GAIN CONTROL MAY NOT BE DETERMINED BY THE TYPE OF INTERNEURON, BUT RATHER BY INTRINSIC PROPERTIES OF A TARGET NEURON. The property is attributed to the wrong cell
which the review turns into a rule about the method: INFERRING THE PRESENCE OF DIVISIVE OR SUBTRACTIVE INHIBITION FROM OPTOGENETIC MANIPULATIONS CAN BE PROBLEMATIC

A CATEGORY BORROWED FROM ANOTHER CELL TYPE, WITH THE NON-IDENTITY STATED: REGULAR SPIKING AND BURSTING FIRING TYPES WERE ORIGINALLY DESCRIBED FOR CORTICAL PYRAMIDAL NEURONS, and THE FIRING PROPERTIES OF RS OR BURSTING SOM CELLS ARE ANALOGOUS BUT NOT IDENTICAL TO THOSE CLASSICALLY OBSERVED IN PYRAMIDAL NEURONS
and the same cells move the opposite way in the neighboring paradigm: THIS INCREASE IN SOM RESPONSIVENESS CONTRASTS WITH THE DECREASED SOM RESPONSIVENESS DURING STIMULUS-SPECIFIC ADAPTATION

THE CLASS CANNOT BE PERTURBED ALONE: IT IS VIRTUALLY IMPOSSIBLE TO PERTURB THE ACTIVITY OF THE SOM NETWORK WITHOUT CHANGING FIRING PATTERNS IN OTHER INHIBITORY NEURONS, WHICH MAY LEAD TO CONFLICTING AND MISLEADING RESULTS
and the review's closing instruction to its own readers: IT IS IMPORTANT TO REMEMBER THAT SOM CELLS ARE NOT A SINGLE POPULATION, BUT RATHER CONSIST OF SEVERAL DISTINCT CLASSES OF INHIBITORY CELLS
and what that substance does where the review is set is not known: THE CELLULAR AND SYNAPTIC EFFECTS OF SOM RELEASE IN CORTEX HAVE NOT BEEN STUDIED

the same class behaving oppositely in one sensory system: IN BARREL CORTEX SOM CELLS ARE SUPPRESSED DURING STIMULUS PRESENTATION, AND THUS ARE ANTI-CORRELATED WITH NETWORK ACTIVITY, A FEATURE WHICH HAS NOT BEEN OBSERVED IN OTHER SENSORY REGIONS

THE SAME CONTRAST GETS A DIFFERENT NAME UNDER A DIFFERENT INSTRUMENT: deviant minus standard is called mismatch negativity in the electrophysiology and mismatch response in the calcium imaging, because the indicator's responses go up rather than down and decay slowly

A THIRD CONDITION IS BUILT TO CONTAIN NEITHER RIVAL: the many-standards block is rare like the deviant and unrepeated like nothing else, so it elicits neither adaptation nor surprise and lets the difference be split in two
and the same two stimuli swap roles between blocks, which removes stimulus preference as a confound by construction rather than by correction

THE NULL IS CONSTRUCTED FROM WHAT THE ARTEFACT CANNOT DO: shuffling trial labels within a block preserves every block-to-block difference and destroys only the condition difference, and that shuffle is subtracted region by region
THE CONTROL AREA IS SPOILED BY THE SELECTION PROCEDURE: the stimuli were chosen to drive parietal cortex, so a null in visual cortex says nothing, and the paper says so
AND THE POPULATION AVERAGE SHOWS NOTHING: multi-unit firing gave no difference across conditions, with the signal proposed to live in select cells invisible to a neuron-averaged rate
the negative result is defended rather than buried: the absence of deviance detection is named as something that might be read as diminishing the study, and then turned into the contribution

THE STIMULUS CARRIES TWO FEATURES AT ONCE: opposing directions share an orientation, and orientation does not change between conditions, so the missing effect for one stimulus may be about which feature the cells are tracking

AND THEY SAY THEY CANNOT TELL WHICH IT WAS: `However, this study DID NOT MEASURE the participants' level of health-schematic NOR TO WHAT EXTENT THEIR FOOD CHOICE WAS REFLECTIVE OR NOT.` The distinction that decides whether the finding is a nudge result or its opposite was not measured. Stated plainly, immediately after the interpretation that depends on it, rather than left for a reader to notice

A CONFOUND NAMED AT THE CONCEPTUAL LEVEL RATHER THAN THE STATISTICAL ONE: `From a conceptual level an important concern to address is that DEFAULT AND VARIETY CONDITIONS ALSO DIFFER IN THE EASINESS TO REACH THE VEGETABLES.` In the default arm people grasped a pre-packed box; in the variety arm they served themselves. So the two conditions differ in effort as well as in the thing being manipulated, and no statistic in the paper separates them. The authors raise it against their own comparison
signature score = mean log2(TPM + 1) across a signature's genes
'Stacked' = pool the selected subtypes, then compare the pool with normal samples
'Separated' = compare each selected subtype with normal samples on its own
'Comparing Across Subtypes' = compare the selected subtypes with each other, not with normal
isoform 'switch' = the isoform carrying most of a gene's expression differs by cancer type
layer-wise relevance propagation = whatever satisfies the constraints; several different algorithms qualify
R_d < 0 = evidence AGAINST the structure being present; R_d > 0 = evidence FOR it
relevance at the output layer = the prediction f(x) itself
'admissible' = satisfying the constraints, which is weaker than 'correct' and the paper says so
microplastic upper bound = 4.75 mm BECAUSE IT IS A STANDARD SIEVE SIZE, not a property of plastic
mesoplastic upper bound = 200 mm BECAUSE THAT IS A TYPICAL PLASTIC WATER BOTTLE
macroplastic lower bound = 200 mm, set by this paper because the field has no established one
the field's generally accepted lower bound, 0.33 mm, is a neuston net's mesh opening
HEA = typically five or more elements in equimolar concentration, giving maximum molar configurational entropy RlnN
delta <= 4% or 4.3% = a NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT criterion, and it is empirical, not derived
the same delta, recomputed from LATTICE CONSTANTS instead of atomic radii, because no radius represents the real bond lengths
delta-c is the discriminating one and delta-a is not, because the boron net constrains the a-axis
stability is REVOCABLE: these materials can be bumped off the hull by future discoveries, exactly as this work bumps off 5,000 others
'meaningfully stable' = distributed like known stable phases, not merely filling gaps in the hull
'experimental match' = integer-rounded composition match AND a pymatgen structure match, declared a lower bound
'fear of COVID-19' = the SEVEN ITEMS that survived 30 measures, two expert panels and one correlation cutoff
scoring = seven items, 1 to 5 each, summed to a range of 7 to 35
'valid' here = correlating with the HADS and the PVDS; there is no external criterion for fear
a mean is REPORTABLE only where the analyte was detected in at least 60% of samples
RACE/ETHNICITY is three self-reported categories, and everyone else is counted in the total but excluded from every subgroup comparison
a CONFOUNDER is a variable whose re-addition moves a beta coefficient by 10% or more
a RETAINED model term is one surviving backward elimination at p < 0.05
'conspiracy theory' = an explanation of an important event by secret plots of powerful and malevolent groups
the three-motive taxonomy is called 'a useful HEURISTIC', borrowed from system-justification theory rather than derived
'high-entropy alloy' = FIVE OR MORE elements at high concentration, crystallising as a single phase
the new loss treats boxes with opposite directions as the SAME by design, and a separate classifier recovers the direction
the direction target is defined by a sign test on yaw: positive above zero, negative otherwise
'state of the art' here is dataset-relative: 90% AP for 2D car detection against 15% for 3D image-based

TEN NAMES FOR OVERLAPPING TASKS, AND THE FIELD IS DECLARED TO HAVE NO AGREEMENT ABOUT ANY OF THEM: `THERE IS NO UNIVERSAL AGREEMENT IN THE LITERATURE ON THE DEFINITIONS OF VARIOUS VISION SUBTASKS. Terms such as DETECTION, LOCALIZATION, RECOGNITION, CLASSIFICATION, CATEGORIZATION, VERIFICATION, IDENTIFICATION, ANNOTATION, LABELING, AND UNDERSTANDING ARE OFTEN DIFFERENTLY DEFINED`. A survey cannot proceed without saying which it means, and the field supplies ten words and no map.

`exosome` CANNOT BE SEPARATED FROM WHAT ISOLATES IT: `even these methods FAIL TO EXCLUSIVELY ISOLATE exosomes, and typically result in COMPLEX MIXTURES of EVs and other components of the extracellular space`. The category is operational, and the operation does not respect the category.

AND THE REASON IS THAT THE CATEGORIES OVERLAP IN THE PROPERTIES THE INSTRUMENTS READ: `the DRASTIC OVERLAP in the physiochemical and biochemical properties between exosomes and different EVs, and the HETEROGENEITY AMONG EXOSOMES THEMSELVES`. The boundary is not merely hard to measure; the paper says the measurable properties do not carry it.

A WORD REMOVED FROM A DEFINITION BECAUSE OF WHAT IT EXCLUDED: `‘naturally’ (as in ‘naturally released’) HAS BEEN REMOVED TO AVOID UNINTENDED EXCLUSION OF ENGINEERED EVs or EVs produced under various cell culture conditions`. The extension was wrong at one edge and a single adverb was deleted to fix it.

THE VERSIONS ARE CUMULATIVE, NOT REPLACING: `The earlier MISEV recommendations REMAIN LARGELY OR ENTIRELY VALID, and MISEV2023 SHOULD BE READ IN THE CONTEXT OF THE PREVIOUS DOCUMENTS.` A reader cannot use the current version alone, which is the opposite of how CONSORT 2010 supersedes CONSORT 2001.

`microvesicle` IS AN ALIAS AND A DISCOURAGED TERM IN THE SAME DOCUMENT, AND BOTH STATEMENTS ARE DELIBERATE. The nomenclature table says `Microvesicle ... This term can therefore lead to confusion. DISCOURAGED`; six pages away the prose says `the term ‘ECTOSOME’ (A.K.A., MICROVESICLE, MICROPARTICLE) refers to EVs from the cell surface.` **The a.k.a. is telling the reader what the discouraged word MEANT so they can decode the older literature; the verdict is telling them not to write it.** Those are compatible and they look contradictory in any index that stores a term with a verdict and no scope. A corpus that records `microvesicle: discouraged` without recording `microvesicle = ectosome, for reading old papers` loses the half that makes the retirement usable.

exosome, AS USED IN THE LITERATURE THIS REVIEW SURVEYS: the pellet from a 100,000x g spin. The two senses are in the same paper, two paragraphs apart, and the second is the one the experiments actually use

THE COINING, 1987, WITH ITS REASON: Rose Johnstone chose `exosome` because `the process seemed to be akin to reverse endocytosis`. The name was an analogy to a MECHANISM from the start, which is why it could never be settled by a measurement of the product
circRNA, AS THE CATEGORY STOOD BEFORE 2012: `described decades ago in a variety of model systems, BUT THEY WERE CONSIDERED RARE EVENTS`. A class of molecule inside the error term

circRNA, AFTER THIS PAPER: protein-coding, at least sometimes. AND THE KEYWORD LIST OF THIS VERY ARTICLE STILL READS `non-coding RNA`. The class is filed under a property the paper disproves for one of its members

selectivity, AS DEFINED IN THE METHODS: the reciprocal of the number of clusters an auto-annotation would apply to, so a gene set matching k clusters scores 1/k. A DEFINITION OF DISTINCTIVENESS THAT IS A CHOICE OF DENOMINATOR

THE ONE PLACE `TRUE` IS EARNED, AND THE PAPER SAYS WHY IT CHOSE IT: PRO-seq, picked `to validate RNAPII CUT&Tag WITHOUT RELYING UPON ANNOTATIONS` because it `provides direct mapping of RNAPII USING A METHOD THAT IS UNRELATED TO CHROMATIN PROFILING`. The independence is the argument, and it is stated as the reason for the choice

and ATAC-seq is the counter-case that motivates the whole design: it maps accessible and factor-bound sites but `THE SPECIFIC CHROMATIN PROTEINS BOUND AT THESE SITES MUST BE INFERRED`. A method that sees WHERE but not WHO

THE DIAGNOSIS, WHICH IS THIS PROJECT'S OWN THESIS IN ONE CLAUSE: `the underlying meaning of each of the principles IS CONTESTED, WITH SIMILAR TERMS OFTEN USED TO MEAN DIFFERENT THINGS`. A shared word list is not a shared vocabulary

the formal conditions for agreement, stated exactly: SUFFICIENCY implies equality of positive predictive values, SEPARATION implies equality of false positive rates, and both hold together only if recidivism rates and score distributions are the same across racial groups, or some group never experiences an outcome at all

and the term has a datable origin the paper gives: `THIS TERM WAS ORIGINALLY PHRASED BY MOSCOVICI (1987)`, for whom a conspiracy was an `indissoluble secret bond` whose object is `to foment upheaval in society, pervert societal values, aggravate crises, promote defeat`

FOUR INSTRUMENTS FOR ONE CONSTRUCT, AND THE TWO CALLING THEMSELVES GENERIC DISAGREE ABOUT ITS SHAPE. Brotherton's Generic Conspiracist Beliefs Scale: 15 items, FIVE components. This paper's CMQ: 5 items, ONE dimension. Same journal, same year, same construct name

THE TWO INSTRUMENTS, COMPARED BY THIS PAPER: the GCB `SPECIFIES THE CONTENT AND OBJECTIVES of some conspiracies while remaining non-specific about ENTITIES OR EVENTS`; the CMQ `REMAINS LARGELY NON-SPECIFIC IN REGARDS TO BOTH`. They differ in HOW MUCH CONTENT AN ITEM MAY CARRY, which is the only axis there is

the dimensionality disagreement, DISSOLVED rather than won: five facets is `NOT INCONSISTENT WITH other research which has found conspiracist ideation to be UNIDIMENSIONAL`, because the five `WERE HIGHLY INTERCORRELATED`. Both papers can be right about the same people

trust, IN FIVE CHARACTERISTICS: A has CONFIDENCE in B to do X; A believes in B's COMPETENCE; A is VULNERABLE to B's actions; there is a possibility B will BETRAY A's trust; and A believes B is MOTIVATED to do X for affective or normative reasons. THE LAST TWO ARE THE ONES AI FAILS

THE THREE Cs HAVE BECOME FIVE AND ONE OF THE ORIGINALS IS GONE. macdonald2015's model was CONFIDENCE, COMPLACENCY, CONVENIENCE. The 5-C scale named here is `confidence, complacency, CONSTRAINTS, CALCULATION, and COLLECTIVE RESPONSIBILITY`. Convenience is not in it, and nothing in this paper marks the substitution

the disease, BEFORE ANY VIRUS: defined by `clinical symptoms and other criteria, including a rise in body temperature, decreases in the number of lymphocytes and white blood cells ..., new pulmonary infiltrates on chest radiography and NO OBVIOUS IMPROVEMENT AFTER TREATMENT WITH ANTIBIOTICS FOR THREE DAYS`. A definition partly by failure of a treatment

circular RNA, AFTER: `previously thought to be very rare, ARE ACTUALLY A PERVASIVE FEATURE of eukaryotic gene expression programs; indeed, THE MAJOR RNA ISOFORM FROM HUNDREDS OF HUMAN GENES IS A CIRCLE`. Same molecules, same data type, one changed alignment rule

the noise hypothesis, STATED AS A PREDICTION AND THEN TESTED: `under this model, WE WOULD EXPECT A POSITIVE RELATIONSHIP between linear RNA isoform expression from a given gene and the probability of detecting a circular RNA isoform from that gene. WE FOUND NO EVIDENCE OF SUCH A RELATIONSHIP`

and the replacement is AN ENUMERATION, NOT A CRITERION: heavy metals as `(1) transition elements; (2) rare earth elements ...; and (3) A HETEROGENEOUS GROUP including the metal Bi, the elements that form amphoteric oxides ... and the metalloids Ge, As and Te`. A list beat a property, because the property let non-members in

AND THE SAME PAPER USES A SECOND, PHYSICAL, YARDSTICK IN THE SAME UNITS: `The DTNN errors are MUCH SMALLER THAN THE ENERGY OF THERMAL FLUCTUATIONS AT ROOM TEMPERATURE (~0.6 kcal mol-1), MEANING THAT DTNN potential-energy surfaces CAN BE UTILIZED to calculate accurate molecular thermodynamic properties`. THE FIRST THRESHOLD NAMES THE CLASS; THE SECOND LICENSES A USE

and `unquestioning acceptor` + `cautious acceptor` TOGETHER come from ONE of Benin's: `Both this category and unquestioning acceptors were DRAWN FROM Benin's category of vaccination acceptors`. SO ONE SOURCE CATEGORY SPLITS INTO TWO TARGETS WHILE TWO OTHER SOURCE CATEGORIES MERGE INTO ONE OF THEM

and the class's STATUS changed without its extension changing: `initially proposed as CELLULAR WASTE ... and HAVE NO SIGNIFICANT IMPACT on neighboring cells. It is only recently that these extracellular vesicles are FUNCTIONAL VEHICLES`

`subclass` = `one term being MORE SPECIFIC THAN another term`, and the paper gives both names in one clause: `such as one term being more specific than another term (ALSO CALLED SUBCLASS)`. A relation named twice, once relationally and once formally
reviewed UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot entries: records whose data are added by expert biocurators
unreviewed UniProtKB/TrEMBL entries: records annotated by automated systems
UniParc: the archive retaining known sequences including obsolete sequences
proteome: the set of proteins currently believed to be expressed by an organism
Reference Proteome: a stably maintained, best-annotated representative selected by community choice or clustering
gene-centric subset: one algorithmically selected representative protein per gene, unlike the isoform-inclusive full proteome
expert curation: evaluation of experimental literature and summarization in reviewed Swiss-Prot records
ARBA: a multiclass self-training system that mines concise automatic-annotation rules
UniRule: similarity-based semi-automated annotation from experimentally characterized proteins
PEFF: extended FASTA format carrying variation and sequence metadata for proteomic tools
ORCID: personal researcher identifier used to validate submissions and assign contribution credit
COVID-19 disease portal: pre-release disease-centric access updated faster than the ordinary UniProt cycle
community curation: user-submitted publications and basic annotations minimally checked by an experienced curator
Nightingale components: lightweight modular visualization components reusable in external resources
template entries: expert-curated records that support information transfer to related-species proteins
microbial communities: multi-species assemblages whose members interact in a contiguous environment
genomic or method-driven microbiome definitions: sequence-centered definitions that change when the technology changes
holobiont theory: host and microbiota treated together as the biological unit
dysbiosis: altered microbial composition following diversity loss and linked to cascading host effects
virome: viral shotgun metagenomic nucleic acids associated with an ecosystem or holobiont
horizontal gene transfer: movement of plasmids, bacteriophages, or transposons between strains, destabilizing strain genomes
hub species: the most highly connected taxa in a co-occurrence network, not automatically keystone species
keystone species: taxa proposed to influence ecosystem performance and dynamics disproportionately
indicator taxa: taxa highly indicative of a treatment or environmental condition
temporal dynamics: change from minute-scale transcripts to host-associated coevolution over centuries or millennia
core microbiome: members shared among consortia from similar habitats and stable across complex assemblages
functional core microbiota: microbial vehicles carrying genes essential to holobiont fitness
amplicon sequence variants: exact marker-gene labels resolved to single-nucleotide differences
coevolution: reciprocal adaptation of lineages in response to one another
pathobiome: a pathogenic agent considered inside its biotic environment
Anna Karenina principle: dysbiotic individuals vary more in community composition than healthy individuals
PMA: membrane-selective treatment whose DNA cross-linking suppresses PCR amplification from damaged cells
One Health: coordinated multi-sector work linking public, animal, and environmental health
microbial hotspots: spatial zones with substantially more actively metabolizing microorganisms than non-hotspots
microbiome management: direct addition of communities, microbes, or metabolites, or indirect environmental shifting

delimiter_ambiguities.label: a rate of semantic change - A NUMBER PRODUCED BY A CHOICE OF EMBEDDING: PPMI, SVD and SGNS are ranked against each other by the paper itself, PPMI is called clearly worse and prone to false discoveries from genre shifts, and between the other two the result is equivocal - so the construct's value depends on an instrument the paper declines to settle
delimiter_ambiguities.head: a rate of semantic change

delimiter_ambiguities.label: 'quantum supremacy' - AS ITS COINER DEFINED IT, WITH USEFULNESS EXCLUDED: a task no existing or easily foreseeable classical device could perform, disregarding whether it is useful, and he adds that from a commercial perspective usefulness obviously does matter - so the word names a milestone in capability and not in value
delimiter_ambiguities.head: 'quantum supremacy'

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `extremes` - LEFT UNDEFINED ON PURPOSE, AND THE BENCHMARK DROPS THE PHENOMENON RATHER THAN PICK A DEFINITION: `DEFINING EXTREMES IS AMBIGUOUS WHICH IS WHY THERE IS NO STANDARD METRIC for evaluating extremes ... we decided to OMIT EXTREMES FOR NOW but users are encouraged to chose their own verification`. THE AMBIGUITY IS UPSTREAM OF THE METRIC AND THE MISSING METRIC IS UPSTREAM OF THE BENCHMARK'S SCOPE - a definitional problem propagating into what a whole field will be measured on.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `extremes`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: THE ACCOUNT Humphries2018 TESTED AND DID NOT REPLICATE, and the two records are three hours apart in this corpus. Humphries changed the RESPONSE HAND - a manipulation the binding account predicts should break the saving - and found a negligible effect, noting that the study which did find one contrasted VERBAL with KEYPRESS responses. That is this paper. So the corpus holds the account, its confirmation, and a null against it at a smaller manipulation, with both papers' own hedges attached
delimiter_ambiguities.head: THE ACCOUNT Humphries2018 TESTED AND DID NOT REPLICATE, and the two records are three hours apart in this corpus. Humphries changed the RESPONSE HAND

delimiter_ambiguities.label: PRIMING AS AN INSTRUMENT, IN A LITERATURE THAT IS NOT ABOUT PRIMING. The question is which features a semantic category depends on - a question about conceptual structure and about category-specific deficits in patients - and priming is borrowed to answer it. This is the distinction pickering2008 asks its own field to keep (Q-744): an investigation USING priming rather than ABOUT it. Here the borrowing is complete enough that the conclusion mentions categorization and not priming at all

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `cognitive load` - A TWO-PART PARTITION WHOSE HALVES ARE EASILY CONFLATED, AND THIS PAPER KEEPS THEM APART. `COGNITIVE LOAD CONSISTS OF TWO CONSTRUCTS: MENTAL LOAD AND MENTAL EFFORT.` The names differ by one word and both read as `how hard it feels`. **The distinction is between what the TASK imposes and what the LEARNER expends**, and a corpus that carries only one of the two - as this record did - silently makes `cognitive load` mean whichever half it kept.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `cognitive load`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `ARCS` - AN ACRONYM WHOSE LETTERS ARE ITS PARTITION, LIKE `WEIRD` IN `henrich2010`. `The ARCS theory construct CONSISTS OF FOUR SUB-CONSTRUCTS: ATTENTION, RELEVANCE, CONFIDENCE, AND SATISFACTION (SAT).` The name cannot drift from its content because the content spells the name - **and the same sentence then gives `satisfaction` a SECOND abbreviation, `SAT`, so one construct carries two acronyms at different levels.**
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `ARCS`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: and an internal tension is stated outright - stimulus-specific mismatch responses but adaptation for both stimuli - with a proposed resolution offered as a proposal
