delimiter_ambiguities.label: **AND THE CROSS-SPECIES RESULT IS A DIFFERENCE, NOT A CONFIRMATION:** `First, in mice, the priming effect is in SUCCESS RATES and not in response times, whereas in humans, the priming effect is BOTH in success rates and response times.` So it is not that the two species use different measures - **humans show the effect in both channels and mice show it in only one.** A weaker paper would have reported that priming generalises to mice; this one reports which measure it lands in and that the human pattern is strictly larger. The concept survives the species change and its operationalisation does not, which is exactly the case a controlled vocabulary handles worst: both would be tagged `priming effect` and the tag would hide the disagreement. **I first quoted the figure caption for this, which says only `in humans, the typical priming effect is in response time` - the looser claim. The discussion is more precise than the caption and I had taken the caption as the paper's position**
delimiter_ambiguities.head: **AND THE CROSS-SPECIES RESULT IS A DIFFERENCE, NOT A CONFIRMATION:** `First, in mice, the priming effect is in SUCCESS RATES and not in response times, whereas in humans, the priming effect is BOTH in success rates and response times.` So it is not that the two species use different measures

delimiter_ambiguities.label: AI, in the curriculum - A SETTLED DEFINITION TO BE TAUGHT: the first component of an AI literacy program is basic definitions and understanding of what AI is, together with a three-way type list - narrow, general and superintelligent - which is a settled account of the term, in a literature whose own reviews cannot agree one
delimiter_ambiguities.head: AI, in the curriculum

delimiter_ambiguities.label: executive functions - AS DIVIDED HERE: three components following Miyake et al. (2000) — updating or working memory, inhibition, and shifting
delimiter_ambiguities.head: executive functions

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `updating` / `working memory` - AN ALIAS ASSERTED BY A BARE `OR`, AND IT IS THE LOOSEST JOIN IN THIS PAPER. `These are (i) UPDATING OR WORKING MEMORY, the ability to monitor and manipulate information held in mind`. Miyake's component is `updating`; `working memory` is a much older and much broader term that this sentence quietly equates with it. **The paper's own later sections then distinguish VERBAL from VISUOSPATIAL working memory and report they behave differently** - a distinction `updating` does not carry. The `or` does more work than it admits.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `updating` / `working memory`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `executive functions` - DEFINED BY WHAT THEY ARE FOR, THEN IMMEDIATELY BY A THREE-WAY PARTITION. `EXECUTIVE FUNCTIONS, THE SKILLS USED TO GUIDE AND CONTROL THOUGHT AND ACTION, ARE TYPICALLY DIVIDED INTO THREE MAIN COMPONENTS FOLLOWING MIYAKE ET AL. (2000).` The functional gloss is the paper's own; the partition is attributed, and `typically` marks it as convention rather than fact. **Each component then gets a one-clause definition in the same sentence** - updating, inhibition, shifting - so the whole construct is fixed in 60 words.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `executive functions`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: AI - THREE CHARACTERISATIONS AND NO RULING: the review reports that there are diverse concepts of AI in the literature and that defining it is a problem, then quotes a confluence of technologies, computers that do cognitive functions, and a process that produces human intelligence through machines - three sources, one review, and no statement of which the review is using
delimiter_ambiguities.head: AI

delimiter_ambiguities.label: misconception - AS A CATEGORY ERROR: on the classical model a misconception is a concept assigned to the wrong ontological category, so change means altering what kind of thing the student takes the concept to be - a definition that makes some disagreements invisible
delimiter_ambiguities.head: misconception

delimiter_ambiguities.label: accuracy - ON IMAGES FROM OTHER SOURCES, the same model, the same 38 classes: 31.40% and 31.69%. ONE WORD, TWO POPULATIONS, A THIRTY-EIGHT POINT GAP - and the paper reports both
delimiter_ambiguities.head: accuracy

delimiter_ambiguities.label: plant biostimulant - THE EUROPEAN (EBIC) SENSE: defined by FUNCTION and fenced off from pesticides by regulation - substances or microorganisms that stimulate natural processes, with no direct action against pests
delimiter_ambiguities.head: plant biostimulant

delimiter_ambiguities.label: plant biostimulant - THE NORTH AMERICAN (coalition) SENSE: defined by what it is APPLIED TO and fenced off from fertilisers by claim - may enhance nutrient assimilation, but is not a plant nutrient and may make no nutrient claim. TWO INDUSTRY CONSORTIA, ONE TERM, AND THE BOUNDARY IS DRAWN AGAINST A DIFFERENT NEIGHBOUR ON EACH SIDE OF THE ATLANTIC
delimiter_ambiguities.head: plant biostimulant

delimiter_ambiguities.label: semi-supervised transfer learning - DAUME AND CHATTOPADHYAY'S SENSE: abundant labeled source and NO labeled target. Gong and Blitzer use this same phrase for what Daume calls SUPERVISED - the two labels are swapped between literatures
delimiter_ambiguities.head: semi-supervised transfer learning

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `semi-supervised transfer learning` - GONG AND BLITZER'S SENSE: `abundant labeled source data and LIMITED labeled target data`. THAT IS THE CONFIGURATION Daume and Chattopadhyay CALL SUPERVISED - see senses[4] and the `daume` mechanism on this record, which quote their sentence. One name over two configurations and one configuration under two names, in consecutive sentences.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `semi-supervised transfer learning`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: class comparison - EXPLAINING a difference between phenotypes in terms of consistent pathways or mechanisms. Distinguished by the paper from class DISCOVERY (finding subtypes) and class PREDICTION (assigning a new sample) - three tasks, one dataset, and the paper says which one it is doing
delimiter_ambiguities.head: class comparison

delimiter_ambiguities.label: biostimulant - the 1991 sense, Russo and Berlyn: “materials of little or no fertilizer value that accelerate plant growth” - defined by what it is worth as a fertiliser
delimiter_ambiguities.head: biostimulant

delimiter_ambiguities.label: biostimulant - the 1992 sense, Schmidt: PLANT HORMONE-CONTAINING substances - which the 2017 definition explicitly rules out
delimiter_ambiguities.head: biostimulant

delimiter_ambiguities.label: biostimulant - the 2003 sense, Beard in Schmidt et al.: defined by a RESIDUAL - a response that cannot be attributed to traditional plant nutrients
delimiter_ambiguities.head: biostimulant

delimiter_ambiguities.label: biostimulant - the 2001 sense quoted by Sharma: a PLANT-PROTECTION product working by stimulating defence or by competing with harmful organisms - a definition the others do not share at all
delimiter_ambiguities.head: biostimulant

delimiter_ambiguities.label: barriers - IN THIS STUDY A PARTICIPANT-REPORTED CATEGORY, not a measured obstacle: what people said stopped them, grouped by thematic analysis - lack of instruction, lack of confidence, health, cost
delimiter_ambiguities.head: barriers

delimiter_ambiguities.label: placebo - IN THIS TRIAL NIACIN, AN ACTIVE PLACEBO CHOSEN TO PRODUCE A NOTICEABLE SOMATIC EFFECT, not an inert capsule. The companion trial in the same issue used a very low dose of psilocybin instead. Two teams reached the same result through two different solutions to the same problem - that an inert placebo is unblindable against a psychedelic
delimiter_ambiguities.head: placebo

delimiter_ambiguities.label: food waste - THE PAPER ENUMERATES THREE COMPETING DEFINITIONS AND SAYS WHICH IT USES, which is rare enough to be the reason this record is worth holding. (1) FAO 1981: wholesome edible material intended for human consumption, discarded, lost, degraded or eaten by pests anywhere in the chain. (2) Stuart 2009: as (1) PLUS edible material fed to animals or diverted as a processing by-product. (3) Smil 2004: as (1) and (2) PLUS OVER-NUTRITION - the gap between energy consumed and energy needed. The paper adopts the first two and states that the second is only usable where nutritional data on animal feed exist
delimiter_ambiguities.head: food waste

delimiter_ambiguities.label: food waste vs food LOSS - NOT SYNONYMS AND THE DIFFERENCE IS WHERE THE REMEDY GOES. `Food loss` is used post-harvest and names a decrease in quantity or quality; `food waste` is used at the consumer end and relates to behaviour. Losses want investment in infrastructure, waste wants behavioural change - so which word a study uses commits it to a class of intervention
delimiter_ambiguities.head: food waste vs food LOSS

delimiter_ambiguities.label: the war as CAUSE - THE PAPER'S OWN THESIS IS THAT IT IS NOT THE CAUSE, IT IS THE TRIGGER. The consequences are said to be `exacerbated by a variety of underlying rigidities, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies in global food systems`, which makes the war a stressor on a system already fragile - and it is why the conclusion is about food-system reform rather than about the war
delimiter_ambiguities.head: the war as CAUSE

delimiter_ambiguities.label: the `comparison` - ONE SIDE IS MEASURED AND THE OTHER IS MODELLED, and the abstract says so in a clause easy to read past: conventional figures come from CROP BUDGETS AND GOVERNMENT STATISTICS, hydroponic figures are THEORETICAL DATA DERIVED BY ENGINEERING EQUATIONS POPULATED WITH LITERATURE VALUES. So `11x higher yields, 82x more energy` compares an observed system with a calculated one. Legitimate, and not what a reader assumes from the word `comparison` - every quantity on this record inherits it
delimiter_ambiguities.head: the `comparison`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: false-alarm rate - AN EMPIRICAL RATE MEASURED AGAINST TIME-SHIFTED DATA, NOT A PROBABILITY THAT THE EVENT IS NOISE. Where a candidate outranks every background trigger the search can only report a BOUND, and the bound depends on how much background time was available - which is why some FARs here are larger than the ones previously published for the same events
delimiter_ambiguities.head: false-alarm rate

delimiter_ambiguities.label: nutrient concentration, when an aquaponic solution is compared with a hydroponic one - A MEASUREMENT, NOT A QUANTITY OF NUTRIENT. Electrical conductivity and aqueous filtration see only ions, and aquaponic dissolved solids include organic molecules with nutrients locked inside them. So the aquaponic column reads lower partly because the instrument cannot see what is there - and the authors print the comparison and this objection to it on the same page
delimiter_ambiguities.head: nutrient concentration, when an aquaponic solution is compared with a hydroponic one

delimiter_ambiguities.label: challenge, the paper's own organising word - IT COVERS TWO DIFFERENT THINGS AND THE review does not separate them. Some challenges are engineering problems with candidate solutions (pH drift, and a lime-bed reactor to fix it). Others are ABSENCES IN THE LITERATURE - two economic studies, no comparison available, parameters unreported. A reader counting `challenges` counts both kinds together
delimiter_ambiguities.head: challenge, the paper's own organising word

delimiter_ambiguities.label: pre-pandemic baseline - THE ELIGIBILITY CRITERION, AND THE ONE THAT DID THE WORK. A prevalence survey run during the pandemic was not admissible without comparable data from before it, however large or well conducted. 5,683 sources became 48. Both COVID-19 mental health papers in this corpus - wang2020 and lai2020 - are cross-sectional with no pre-pandemic measurement and would fail it
delimiter_ambiguities.head: pre-pandemic baseline

delimiter_ambiguities.label: modality weight - A PER-CELL NUMBER, NOT A PER-DATASET ONE, AND THE PAPER SAYS IT HAS TWO POSSIBLE MEANINGS. It is a proxy for the TECHNICAL QUALITY of a measurement in that cell, and it `may also reflect the BIOLOGICAL IMPORTANCE of each modality in determining cellular identity` - progenitors and differentiated cells came out with divergent weights. The same figure can mean `this instrument worked here` or `this axis is what this cell is`, and nothing in the number distinguishes them
delimiter_ambiguities.head: modality weight

delimiter_ambiguities.label: the boundaries are LOGISTIC rather than conceptual - net and sieve sizes - and are declared as such
delimiter_ambiguities.head: the boundaries are LOGISTIC rather than conceptual

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `common view` / `classical view` - THE FRAMEWORK THIS PAPER IS AGAINST HAS TWO NAMES, AND THE SECOND APPEARS EXACTLY ONCE: `a set of beliefs were refer to as THE COMMON VIEW (ALSO CALLED THE CLASSICAL VIEW)`. `content_tags.definitions[1]` already glosses `Common view`; **what was missing is that the literature this paper argues with calls it something else.** A reader searching the corpus for `classical view` - which is what the opposing literature calls itself - would not have reached this record.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `common view` / `classical view`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: xCell's performance - IN REAL MIXTURES: significantly better than the alternatives and still, in the authors' words, far from perfect - and beaten outright on CD8+ T cells by using one gene
delimiter_ambiguities.head: xCell's performance

delimiter_ambiguities.label: a training set of M structures - COUNTED AS LABELS: M(3N + 1), because each structure carries one energy and 3N force components - the authors raise this themselves before claiming efficiency
delimiter_ambiguities.head: a training set of M structures

delimiter_ambiguities.label: the mouse microbiota - IN THE WILD: resilient, and shown to recapitulate human phenotypes better - laboratory mice receiving it become less susceptible to influenza and to colitis-induced tumorigenesis
delimiter_ambiguities.head: the mouse microbiota

delimiter_ambiguities.label: prebiotic - AS DEFINED IN 2015 by Bindels et al.: limited to the gut microbiota, excluding extraintestinal sites such as vagina and skin, and with the requirement for selective fermentation REMOVED - the definition this panel was convened to replace
delimiter_ambiguities.head: prebiotic

delimiter_ambiguities.label: prebiotic - AS DEFINED IN 2017: a substrate that is selectively utilized by host microorganisms conferring a health benefit - selectivity restored, no food requirement, no site requirement
delimiter_ambiguities.head: prebiotic

delimiter_ambiguities.label: prebiotic - AS DEFINED IN 2004: `selectively fermented ingredients that allow specific changes ... in the gastrointestinal microflora that confers benefits upon host well-being and health`, carrying THREE explicit criteria - resist host digestion, be fermented by intestinal microorganisms, and selectively stimulate health-associated intestinal bacteria.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: prebiotic

delimiter_ambiguities.label: prebiotic - AS DEFINED IN 2008 BY AN FAO/UN TECHNICAL MEETING: `a non-viable food component that confers a health benefit on the host associated with modulation of the microbiota`. SELECTIVE FERMENTATION WAS REMOVED, AND THE DEFINITION WAS THEN CRITICISED FOR NOT EXCLUDING ANTIBIOTICS - a definition whose extension was wrong in a way anyone could check.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: prebiotic

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `AI` - AS THE AUTHOR READS IT: a collective term for a wide range of technologies, or an abstract large-scale phenomenon - which is why no guideline goes into technical detail
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `AI`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: gut microbiota - AS DEFINED HERE: the collection of bacteria, archaea and eukarya colonising the GI tract, co-evolved with the host - the term covers three domains and not only bacteria
delimiter_ambiguities.head: gut microbiota

delimiter_ambiguities.label: exosome - AS DEFINED HERE: a subtype of EV formed BY AN ENDOSOMAL ROUTE, typically 30-150 nm - the definition is by ORIGIN, and origin is not what any assay observes
delimiter_ambiguities.head: exosome

delimiter_ambiguities.label: deep learning - AS DEFINED HERE: computational models of multiple processing layers learning representations at multiple levels of abstraction, MIMICKING how the brain perceives multimodal information - the definition carries a brain analogy inside it
delimiter_ambiguities.head: deep learning

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `scRNA-seq` - A NAME FOR A CLASS, NOT A PROTOCOL, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO IN ITS DEFINING SENTENCE. `(scRNA-seq) REFERS TO A CLASS OF METHODS for profiling the transcriptome of individual cells.` **Two papers both reporting `scRNA-seq` may share no step of their procedure** - the review goes straight on to distinguish methods taking a census of mRNA at the 3' or 5' end from those assessing full transcripts. The term is a citation-level abstraction that is never a method-level one.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `scRNA-seq`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: microplastic - AS DEFINED HERE: plastic particles under 5 mm, AND THE DEFINITION COMMONLY INCLUDES the nano-scale below 1 micrometre. koelmans2019, in this corpus, says particles below 1 micrometre are usually called NANOPLASTICS RATHER THAN microplastic - the same boundary drawn the opposite way
delimiter_ambiguities.head: microplastic

delimiter_ambiguities.label: operational term - the document's remedy and its own coinage: a prefix on `EV` stating the characteristic the population was actually separated on - size, density, molecular composition, cellular origin. DEFINE BY WHAT WAS MEASURED
delimiter_ambiguities.head: operational term

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `extracellular vesicles` - THE 2023 DEFINITION, ALL THREE CLAUSES NEGATIVE OR STRUCTURAL AND NONE ABOUT ORIGIN: `particles that are RELEASED FROM CELLS, are DELIMITED BY A LIPID BILAYER, and CANNOT REPLICATE ON THEIR OWN`. Nothing about where in the cell they came from - which is the whole point of the accompanying deprecations.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `extracellular vesicles`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `EV mimetic` - A TERM CHOSEN TO STOP A NAME SMUGGLING IN A CLAIM: `This term is PREFERRED OVER ‘exosome‐like vesicles’ AND SIMILAR TERMS THAT IMPLY SPECIFIC BIOGENESIS‐RELATED PROPERTIES.` The rejected names are not wrong about what the particles ARE - they are wrong about what has been SHOWN. A name that asserts an unproven origin is treated here as a methodological fault, not a stylistic one.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `EV mimetic`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `exosome` - THE USAGE VERDICT, WHICH IS SEPARATE FROM THE MEANING THIS RECORD ALREADY CARRIES AT senses[1]: MISEV2023 grades it **`Discouraged unless subcellular origin can be demonstrated`**. NOT abolished and NOT redefined - PERMITTED ON A CONDITION, and the condition is evidential rather than semantic. The document runs a THREE-LEVEL SCALE - `Recommended`, `Recommended, but caution required`, `Discouraged unless ...` - so a nomenclature body here is grading terms by HOW MUCH EVIDENCE THEIR USE PRESUPPOSES, not by whether they are correct.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `exosome`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `Microvesicle` - A TERM RETIRED FOR THE OPPOSITE OF VAGUENESS: IT MEANS SOMETHING PRECISE AND NOBODY USED IT THAT WAY. `Microvesicle BIOGENESIS-RELATED TERM INDICATING ORIGIN FROM THE PLASMA MEMBRANE. HOWEVER, HISTORICALLY, THE TERM HAS OFTEN BEEN USED TO DESIGNATE LARGE EVs OR ALL EVs, WHATEVER THEIR SUBCELLULAR ORIGIN. This term can therefore lead to confusion. DISCOURAGED.` **The definition is not in dispute; the usage diverged from it and the consortium retires the word rather than the definition.** Compare `thery2018`, which retired the same term for a DIFFERENT stated fault - `manifold, contradictory definitions` AND `inaccurate expectations of unique biogenesis`. **Two consortium documents, five years apart, retire one word and give different reasons for it.**
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `Microvesicle`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `optimal` spacer length - AS USED HERE, TWICE OVER. In principle a derived quantity (epitope position, steric hindrance); in practice an empirical one, tailored per pair. THE PAPER'S OWN SCARE QUOTES MARK THE GAP - a property defined by a theory and decided by trying it
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `optimal` spacer length

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `timely manner` - AND THE ONLY NUMBER THE PAPER ATTACHES TO IT IS A DECISION RULE, NOT A DEFINITION: at 4 weeks of standard care without sufficient healing, reassess and consider advanced agents. FOUR WEEKS IS WHEN YOU CHANGE TREATMENT, NOT WHEN THE WOUND BECOMES CHRONIC - and the paper does not claim otherwise, which is the honest version of this gap
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `timely manner`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `margin` - ONE TERM, TWO DIFFERENT KINDS OF OBJECT, AND THE SURVEY RECORDS BOTH WITHOUT CHOOSING: `the _margin_, WHICH IS DEFINED AS THE DISTANCE between the decision boundary and the data points closest to it. THE TERM IS ALSO COMMONLY USED TO DESCRIBE THE AREA extruding from the decision boundary in which no data points lie.` A SCALAR AND A REGION. Not two readings of one quantity - two different types, so `maximise the margin` and `lies within the margin` are grammatical with different referents, and only one of them can be a number. This record already carries a declared type error kept on purpose at `senses[3]` and two senses of `abuse of notation` at `senses[4]`; this is the same survey's third type-level observation, and the only one it does not flag as its own.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `margin`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `miRNA sponging` - A MECHANISM THAT WAS OVER-GENERALISED FROM ITS FIRST CASES, AND THE FIELD SAYS SO. `genome-wide studies have demonstrated that MIRNA SPONGING ACTIVITY CANNOT BE GENERALLY APPLIED ... and other mechanisms have also been proposed.` The term is not wrong; its SCOPE was. **This is a definitional correction that leaves the word intact and changes what it may be said of** - the failure mode mechanism 28 describes, arriving from genome-wide data rather than from argument.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `miRNA sponging`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `marker gene set` - A SET-THEORETIC DEFINITION WHERE THE FIELD USUALLY HAS A BIOLOGICAL INTUITION: `a set of genes that are ALL EXPRESSED IN A GIVEN CLUSTER, BUT NOT ALL EXPRESSED IN ANY OTHER CLUSTER`. The definition is about the SET, not about any gene in it - no single gene need be unique to the cluster.
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `marker gene set`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: major depressive disorder - NOT MEASURED HERE and explicitly `a MORE SEVERE measure of depression` than this paper's outcome. The paper uses the ordering to make a PREDICTION - that MDD estimates should rise too - rather than to claim it found MDD
delimiter_ambiguities.head: major depressive disorder

delimiter_ambiguities.label: confidence - REJECTED AS THE NAME AND KEPT AS A COMPONENT. `The most commonly offered alternative in the literature`, `a more positive word`, refused because it is `still narrow in scope covering only one category of factors` - and then installed as one of the three Cs inside the definition it lost to
delimiter_ambiguities.head: confidence

delimiter_ambiguities.label: AI - `A RESEARCH AREA IN SEARCH OF A DEFINITION` in the paper's own heading. It keeps the 1955 Dartmouth formulation, reads it as A COUNTERFACTUAL (`WERE a human to behave in that way, that behaviour WOULD be called intelligent`), and then substitutes its own working phrase - `a reservoir of smart agency on tap` - justified by fitness for the corpus it is about to analyse
delimiter_ambiguities.head: AI

delimiter_ambiguities.label: conspiracist ideation - THIS PAPER'S HEAD TERM for what bruder2013 calls CONSPIRACY MENTALITY. `individuals' general tendency to engage with conspiracy theories`. Two papers, one journal, one year, one construct, TWO PRIMARY NAMES - and bruder2013 lists this one as an alternative while using the other
delimiter_ambiguities.head: conspiracist ideation

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `trustworthy AI` - A TERM OF ART IN A POLICY DOCUMENT, and the paper's whole target. The HLEG `state that WHILE TRUSTWORTHINESS IS NOT TYPICALLY A PROPERTY ASCRIBED TO MACHINES, THEY WANT TO ASCRIBE IT TO AI` - the term is adopted knowingly, against ordinary usage, exactly as macdonald2015's committee adopted `vaccine hesitancy`
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `trustworthy AI`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `microplastic` - `NO UNIVERSALLY ESTABLISHED DEFINITION EXISTS`, and the common one - up to 5 mm - has NO LOWER BOUND AT ALL. A term whose extension is open at one end
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `microplastic`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `circHIPK3` - A NAME COINED IN THIS PAPER for the circRNA `derived from the HIPK3 gene Exon2`, together with four more it also names - `We TERMED them as circHIPK3.2, circHIPK3.3, circHIPK3.4, circHIPK3.5`. The naming convention and its five instances arrive in the same sentence
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `circHIPK3`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `atomic energy contribution` - A QUANTITY WITH NO UNIQUE PHYSICAL DEFINITION, GIVEN ONE BY A PROCEDURE. The paper concedes `THE INTRINSIC NON-UNIQUENESS OF ATOMIC ENERGY PARTITIONING`, notes that in quantum chemistry `EVERY MOLECULE WOULD CORRESPOND TO A DIFFERENT PARTITIONING`, and then defines it as whatever the model learns - `A TRANSFERABLE AND GLOBAL DRESSED ATOM REPRESENTATION`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `local chemical potential` - DEFINED OUTRIGHT AND WITH THE VERB: `In the context of DTNN, WE DEFINE a local chemical potential as AN ENERGY OF A CERTAIN ATOM TYPE A, LOCATED AT A POSITION r IN THE MOLECULE M` - with the probe allowed to feel the molecule and forbidden to act on it

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `good health` - OPERATIONALLY, EMPLOYABILITY PLUS AN ABSENCE OF RECORDS. `in good health, PERMITTING A FULL TIME JOB WITHOUT RESTRICTION`, with `NO INFORMATION ... ABOUT HABITS ... AND POSSIBLE COMORBIDITIES`. The second cohort uses a stricter sense - `carefully selected on the basis of THE ABSENCE OF ANY CHRONIC DISEASE OR SUBSTANCE/MEDICATIONS` - so the paper carries two senses of health and validates one against the other
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `good health`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `NLR` - `THE ABSOLUTE NEUTROPHIL COUNT WAS DIVIDED BY THE ABSOLUTE LYMPHOCYTE COUNT TO CALCULATE THE NLR`. One sentence, one division, and no cue list the gate holds can see it - `calculated as` is on MEASUREMENT and `to calculate` is not

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `late or selective vaccinator` - THE ONLY POSITION DEFINED BY WHAT THE PARENT DOES RATHER THAN BELIEVES: `Concerns about vaccination result in this group CHOOSING TO DELAY OR SELECT ONLY SOME recommended vaccines`. And it is porous - `With a specific vaccine scare hesitant parents may SELECT-OUT the vaccine and MOVE TO THIS CATEGORY`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `GAN` = `Generative Adversarial Nets`, defined correctly in the body - `the newest DL technique NAMED Generative Adversarial Nets (GAN)` - and WRONGLY in the Abbreviations table as `AN`. The same identity, twice, one right and one not
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `GAN` = `Generative Adversarial Nets`, defined correctly in the body

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `scRNA-seq` - `A BROAD CLASS OF TECHNIQUES which profile the transcriptomes of individual cells`. Defined by what it profiles and at what resolution, not by any one protocol - which is why the QC parameters cannot be fixed
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `scRNA-seq`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `digital transformation` AS DEFINED - `a process that AIMS TO IMPROVE AN ENTITY BY TRIGGERING SIGNIFICANT CHANGES TO ITS PROPERTIES THROUGH COMBINATIONS OF INFORMATION, COMPUTING, COMMUNICATION, AND CONNECTIVITY TECHNOLOGIES`. A definition with one hedge doing all the work - `SIGNIFICANT`
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `digital transformation` AS DEFINED

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `taxonomic change` - AN ENUMERATED TYPE WITH SIX VALUES: `new, split, move, merge, rename, and abolish`. Not prose, not a convention - a controlled field in a SQL schema, stored per taxon per release
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `taxonomic change`

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `crowded` AS AGAINST `concentrated` - TWO NAMES FOR ONE MILIEU, WITH THE CRITERION STATED: media are `KNOWN AS CROWDED RATHER THAN CONCENTRATED environments, as, IN GENERAL, NO INDIVIDUAL MACROMOLECULAR SPECIES MAY BE PRESENT AT HIGH CONCENTRATION`. High total, low per-species - and the second word would imply the opposite
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `crowded` AS AGAINST `concentrated`

An activity, a place and a programme, all called `function`

NOT a redefinition and NOT a correction - a recommendation to stop applying the word in one setting, leaving it live everywhere else. THE CORPUS HAS FEW DEPRECATIONS AND FEWER WITH A DENOMINATOR.

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `hyperprogression` - THE DEFINITION THIS BODY ADOPTED, AND ALMOST A THIRD OF THE ROOM VOTED AGAINST IT: 70.6% recommended `a rapid increase in tumor growth rate (minimum two-fold) compared to the expected growth rate`. THE >=75% CONSENSUS BAR IS NOT IN THIS QUOTE - it is stated separately at `Consensus was defined as >=75% agreement among subcommittee members`, already carried by this record's senses[0] and mechanisms[0]. Reading the two together is what shows 70.6% falling short of the paper's own threshold, and the two-quote span is why that comparison lives in a label and not in an evidence field.

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `polypharmacy` (descriptive, 8.7%) - `more drugs being prescribed or taken than are clinically appropriate in the context of a patient's comorbidities`, and at the other extreme `PATIENTS VISITING MULTIPLE PHARMACIES to obtain medications` - a different referent entirely

delimiter_ambiguities.head: `synergism` (Crain et al. 2008, opposing stressors)

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `stressor` (this paper) - `a variable that, AS A RESULT OF HUMAN ACTIVITY, EXCEEDS ITS RANGE OF NORMAL VARIATION and affects (WHETHER NEGATIVELY OR POSITIVELY) individual taxa, community composition, or ecosystem functioning relative to a reference condition` - against the prior usage as a synonym for pollution

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `microbiome` (Lederberg, THE MOST CITED) - `a community of commensal, symbiotic, and pathogenic microorganisms WITHIN A BODY SPACE OR OTHER ENVIRONMENT` - ecological, host-centred, and not the original
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `microbiome` (Lederberg, THE MOST CITED)

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `sedentary behavior` (SBRN 2012, carried into 2017) - `ANY WAKING BEHAVIOUR CHARACTERIZED BY AN ENERGY EXPENDITURE <=1.5 METs WHILE IN A SITTING OR RECLINING POSTURE` - 558 Scopus citations by March 2017
delimiter_ambiguities.head: `sedentary behavior` (SBRN 2012, carried into 2017)

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `health literacy` - DECLARED TO HAVE NO AGREED DEFINITION, AND THE CONSEQUENCE NAMED: `there is NO CONSENSUS ABOUT THE DEFINITION of health literacy or about its conceptual dimensions, WHICH LIMITS THE POSSIBILITIES FOR MEASUREMENT AND COMPARISON.` The absence is not reported as untidiness - it is reported as the thing preventing the field from measuring anything.

delimiter_ambiguities.label: `proven` IFD - histology, culture or a sterile-site specimen. `Can apply to ANY patient, regardless of whether the patient is immunocompromised` - the only one of the three categories that is not restricted by host

delimiter_ambiguities.head: `MR Egger regression`

examples.label: biostimulant - THIS REVIEW'S SCOPE DECISION: a biofertilizer counts as a biostimulant, a boundary other definitions of the same term explicitly deny

biostimulant - THIS PAPER'S PROPOSED SENSE (2017): defined by EMERGENT PROPERTIES OF THE COMPLEX, and explicitly NOT by the presence of known nutrients, growth regulators or protective compounds. The differentia is what the effect is NOT reducible to
biostimulant - the 1991 sense, Russo and Berlyn: “materials of little or no fertilizer value that accelerate plant growth” - defined by what it is worth as a fertiliser
prebiotic - AS DEFINED IN 1995: a non-digestible FOOD ingredient that selectively stimulates one or a limited number of bacteria ALREADY RESIDENT IN THE COLON

prebiotic - AS DEFINED IN 2015 by Bindels et al.: limited to the gut microbiota, excluding extraintestinal sites such as vagina and skin, and with the requirement for selective fermentation REMOVED - the definition this panel was convened to replace
prebiotic - AS DEFINED IN 2017: a substrate that is selectively utilized by host microorganisms conferring a health benefit - selectivity restored, no food requirement, no site requirement
Transfer learning - pretrain on related simulations, then fine-tune on target observations
transfer learning - the paper's response to its own finding: it refuses the contested labels entirely and states the data conditions each time instead of naming them
transfer learning - AS RECOMMENDED: enhances accuracy across pattern recognition and computer vision, and is the paper's answer to insufficient training data
explicability - the EPISTEMOLOGICAL sense: an answer to “how does it work?”, which the paper names intelligibility

explicability - the ETHICAL sense: an answer to “who is responsible for the way it works?”, which the paper names accountability. ONE COINED TERM CARRYING TWO SENSES BY DESIGN, and the paper says so in the sentence that coins it

explicability - FIVE NAMES FOR ONE PRINCIPLE, LISTED WITH THEIR SOURCES: `TRANSPARENCY` in Asilomar and EGE, `transparency` AND `ACCOUNTABILITY` in IEEE, `INTELLIGIBILITY` in AIUK, `UNDERSTANDABLE AND INTERPRETABLE` in the Partnership. The new term is coined to cover a thing four documents already had
GPGP plastic mass - MEASURED BY NET TRAWLS ALONE: about 4.8 thousand tonnes, from instruments developed to collect neustonic plankton
GPGP plastic mass - NET TRAWLS PLUS VESSEL SIGHTINGS: about 21 thousand tonnes, at the cost of high uncertainty in estimating a sighted object's mass
GPGP plastic mass - NET TRAWLS PLUS MEGA TRAWLS PLUS 311 km2 OF AERIAL IMAGERY: 79 (45-129) thousand tonnes, this study
half-life of serum elimination - the ARITHMETIC mean over the 26 subjects: 5.4 y for PFOS, 8.5 y for PFHS, 3.8 y for PFOA

half-life of serum elimination - the GEOMETRIC mean over the same 26 subjects: 4.8 y for PFOS, 7.3 y for PFHS, 3.5 y for PFOA. These are the three numbers later papers quote as the half-life, without naming the statistic

half-life of serum elimination - the arithmetic mean after removing the two longest-eliminating subjects, which collapses onto the geometric mean and shows the gap between the first two senses is two people

plant biostimulant - THE EUROPEAN (EBIC) SENSE: defined by FUNCTION and fenced off from pesticides by regulation - substances or microorganisms that stimulate natural processes, with no direct action against pests

plant biostimulant - THE NORTH AMERICAN (coalition) SENSE: defined by what it is APPLIED TO and fenced off from fertilisers by claim - may enhance nutrient assimilation, but is not a plant nutrient and may make no nutrient claim. TWO INDUSTRY CONSORTIA, ONE TERM, AND THE BOUNDARY IS DRAWN AGAINST A DIFFERENT NEIGHBOUR ON EACH SIDE OF THE ATLANTIC
plant biostimulant - the paper's own position: A CONCEPT STILL EVOLVING, and the review is written from the two consortium definitions rather than from one of its own
what an MCP-counter score is - IN THE ABSTRACT: a robust quantification of the ABSOLUTE abundance of ten cell populations
what an MCP-counter score is - IN THE RESULTS: a measure of the INTER-SAMPLE RELATIVE abundance of one population

what an MCP-counter score is - IN THE DISCUSSION: linearly correlated with abundance, in ARBITRARY UNITS that depend on the gene expression platform, comparable only between samples run on the same platform
"effectively normalized" - UNDER LOG-NORMALIZATION: true only of the bottom three abundance tiers; high-abundance genes remain confounded with sequencing depth
"effectively normalized" - UNDER PEARSON RESIDUALS: level and variance independent of sequencing depth across the full range of expression

"emotional expression" - AS LICENSED: a facial configuration that reliably and specifically communicates an emotional state. The paper's glossary adds that many so-called emotional expressions are errors of reverse inference
"emotional expression" - AS USED IN THE LITERATURE: any facial configuration labelled with an emotion category, applied without checking reliability, specificity, generalizability or validity
"high TMB" - AS USED throughout the abstract, results, discussion and conclusions: an unquantified clinical category of patients who might benefit from immunotherapy
"high TMB" - AS DEFINED: more than 20 mutations per megabase. The threshold appears once in the paper, in the caption of Fig. 3, and nowhere in the prose

`baseline serum creatinine` - FOR ABOUT HALF THIS COHORT, NOT A MEASUREMENT: the MDRD equation solved backwards `ASSUMING a glomerular filtration rate of 75 ml/minute/1.73 m 2`, then the LOWEST of three candidate values taken
`baseline serum creatinine` - and the rule at its origin: `THE MDRD FORMULA IS USED ONLY TO ESTIMATE THE BASELINE WHEN IT IS NOT KNOWN`

`biostimulant` - DEFINED BY EXCLUSION FROM TWO LEGAL CATEGORIES: `biostimulants CANNOT BY DEFINITION BE PESTICIDES OR FERTILIZERS`, with seven citations behind the exclusion. The category's edges are drawn by its neighbours.

`biostimulant` - AND THE BOUNDARY WITH PGRs IS AN ATTRIBUTION RULE, NOT A COMPOSITION RULE: `biostimulants CAN CONTAIN traces of natural plant hormones, BUT THEIR BIOLOGICAL ACTION SHOULD NOT BE ASCRIBED TO THEM, OTHERWISE THEY SHOULD BE REGISTERED AS PLANT GROWTH REGULATORS.` The same bottle is one product or the other depending on what its effect is credited to.

`hyperprogression` - THE DEFINITION THIS BODY ADOPTED, AND ALMOST A THIRD OF THE ROOM VOTED AGAINST IT: 70.6% recommended `a rapid increase in tumor growth rate (minimum two-fold) compared to the expected growth rate`. THE >=75% CONSENSUS BAR IS NOT IN THIS QUOTE - it is stated separately at `Consensus was defined as >=75% agreement among subcommittee members`, already carried by this record's senses[0] and mechanisms[0]. Reading the two together is what shows 70.6% falling short of the paper's own threshold, and the two-quote span is why that comparison lives in a label and not in an evidence field.

`hyperprogression` - THREE RIVAL DEFINITIONS FROM THE LITERATURE, LISTED BY THE PAPER ITSELF, all quantitative and none equivalent: a RECIST-anchored 2-fold growth-rate ratio [90]; a three-part rule of TTF < two months AND >50% tumour burden increase AND >two-fold progression pace [91]; and a bare tumour growth kinetics ratio >= 2 [79]. THE NUMBER TWO APPEARS IN ALL THREE AND MEASURES A DIFFERENT QUANTITY IN EACH.
`microplastic` - `NO UNIVERSALLY ESTABLISHED DEFINITION EXISTS`, and the common one - up to 5 mm - has NO LOWER BOUND AT ALL. A term whose extension is open at one end

`microplastic` - A PURE SIZE CLASS. `synthetic solid particles or polymeric matrices, with regular or irregular shape and WITH SIZE RANGING FROM 1 um TO 5 mm, of either primary or secondary manufacturing origin, which are insoluble in water`. Two numbers and an insolubility test; everything else in the definition is a disjunction that excludes nothing
`nanoplastic` - <1 um in this literature, `<100 nm` IN THE NANOTECHNOLOGY FIELD. ONE NAME, TWO FIELDS, A TENFOLD DIFFERENCE IN THE THRESHOLD, and the paper reports both rather than choosing

`nanoplastic` - THE SAME KIND OF THING ONE ORDER SMALLER, PLUS AN INTENTION: `particles that are UNINTENTIONALLY PRODUCED within the size range from 1 to 1000 nm`. The upper bound is exactly the microplastic lower bound, and the extra criterion is a fact about manufacture, not about the particle
`open` - AS OQMD MEANS IT: the entire data set downloadable without any conditions or limitations
`open` - AS THE SOURCE IS: the structures come from the ICSD by partnership, and that database is not the thing being given away

`scRNA-seq` - A NAME FOR A CLASS, NOT A PROTOCOL, AND THE PAPER SAYS SO IN ITS DEFINING SENTENCE. `(scRNA-seq) REFERS TO A CLASS OF METHODS for profiling the transcriptome of individual cells.` **Two papers both reporting `scRNA-seq` may share no step of their procedure** - the review goes straight on to distinguish methods taking a census of mRNA at the 3' or 5' end from those assessing full transcripts. The term is a citation-level abstraction that is never a method-level one.

`scRNA-seq` - `A BROAD CLASS OF TECHNIQUES which profile the transcriptomes of individual cells`. Defined by what it profiles and at what resolution, not by any one protocol - which is why the QC parameters cannot be fixed
a COD record's identity - THE COD NUMBER: permanent, assigned once, and never changed even when the file it names is corrected
a COD record's identity - THE REVISION NUMBER: changes on every edit, is written into the file header by software, and is what makes any previous state recoverable
a deposited structure's visibility - UNDER THE ON-HOLD FLAG: cell constants, composition, symmetry and authorship are public and searchable
a deposited structure's visibility - THE COORDINATES UNDER THE SAME FLAG: withheld until publication, or release by the authors, or one year
a parameter set - WITHIN ITS BRANCH: directly combinable, needing only bond and angular terms between the newly combined elements
a parameter set - ACROSS BRANCHES: requiring extensive refitting, with combustion to aqueous the easier direction
a prebiotic effect - AS A PROPERTY OF THE SUBSTANCE: what the category name suggests, and what the panel rejects
a prebiotic effect - AS A PROPERTY OF THE WHOLE EVENT: if pathogens generate the butyrate and the host is harmed, the same molecule is not a prebiotic effect

a questionable source - AS DEFINED HERE: a news OUTLET systematically showing extreme bias, promotion of propaganda or conspiracies, poor sourcing, unverifiable information, a lack of transparency, or fake news
a questionable source - WHAT THE LABEL CANNOT SEE: the individual article. The authors name labelling outlets rather than single articles as the limit of the approach, in the sentence that adopts it

examples.label: a training set of M structures - COUNTED AS CONFIGURATIONS: M, which is the number the data-efficiency claim is made in
a training set of M structures - COUNTED AS LABELS: M(3N + 1), because each structure carries one energy and 3N force components - the authors raise this themselves before claiming efficiency
accuracy of decontam - PER SEQUENCE FEATURE: specificity and sensitivity described as sometimes moderate
accuracy of decontam - PER READ: described as reaching exceptional levels, on the same classifications of the same data. The unit of account decides which number is reported
agreement - BETWEEN TWO EXPERIMENTAL DATABASES: 0.082 eV/atom on the 75 intermetallic compounds they share
agreement - BETWEEN OQMD AND EXPERIMENT: 0.071 eV/atom on the same class, which is closer than the two experiments are to each other

term_head_mismatches.head: agreement of targeted CGP with whole exome

examples.label: agreement of targeted CGP with whole exome - AS ACCURACY: R2 = 0.74, from 29 specimens where both measurements were made on the same biopsy

agreement of targeted CGP with whole exome - AS PRECISION: R2 = 0.98, the assay against itself on 60 replicate pairs. The paper labels this one precision, and it is the number that looks like agreement without being it
an attention map - AS THE PAPER USES IT: a soft region proposal that suppresses background and lets the network localise without a second model
an attention map - AS THE PAPER SAYS IT IS NOT: the object. It outlines the DISCRIMINANT REGION and does not necessarily coincide with the whole structure
an issue covered - AS CODED: explicitly discussed in one or more paragraphs, with isolated mentions not counted
an issue covered - THE EXCEPTION TO THE CODING: unless the guideline is so short that it consists entirely of brief mentions, in which case brief mentions count
an object class - AS A VISUAL GROUPING: what the four similar-looking images in Fig. 6j would suggest, and which the caption says is wrong
an object class - AS A LABEL: a benchmark's annotation, which can hold an astonishing variation in appearance and can separate images that look alike
an omission - UNJUSTIFIED: missing or severely underrepresented without any good reason, such as political abuse or the hidden social and ecological costs of AI
an omission - JUSTIFIED: absent for a reason the analysis can state, which the author separates out rather than counting alongside the first
an oxygen atom - IN ReaxFF's DESIGN: one type, treated with the same mathematical formalism whether it is O2 in gas, water in liquid, or a solid oxide
an oxygen atom - IN PRACTICE: described by combustion-branch parameters or by aqueous-branch parameters, which are not directly transferable
an xCell score - AS COMPUTED: a single-sample gene-set enrichment score, interpretable only against other samples
an xCell score - AS CALIBRATED: deliberately transformed to resemble a proportion so cell types can be compared, and explicitly not usable as a proportion
annotator disagreement - as NOISE: a failure of the scheme or the coders, to be reduced
annotator disagreement - as SIGNAL: a property of the concept, which can be carried into the analysis rather than resolved away
b-MnO2's capacity for zinc - AS CHARACTERISED IN THE LITERATURE: hardly any, because the (1 x 1) tunnels are too narrow to admit Zn2+
b-MnO2's capacity for zinc - AS MEASURED HERE: 307 mAh g-1 on first discharge against a theoretical 308, because the tunnels have stopped existing
bacteria-to-human-cell ratio - counting ALL human cells, including the enucleated red blood cells and platelets that dominate the count: about 1:1

bacteria-to-human-cell ratio - counting only NUCLEATED human cells, which excludes the dominant non-nucleated red-blood-cell population and so returns the larger, older ratio. The paper states its value in a sentence the extraction damaged
citation frequency - number of ARTICLES an author is cited in, which is what every number here means
citation frequency - total mentions, the alternative that was tried and rejected because one article could then stand in for a field
data volume - as ACQUIRED, which for particle physics is enormous
data volume - as STORED, which for genomics is a small fraction of what is produced and for particle physics is smaller still
decision-making phases - Simon's naming: Intelligence, Design and Choice
decision-making phases - the same three stages under a different naming convention: Identification, Development and Selection
deep-sea microplastic abundance - UNDER THE PREVIOUS PROTOCOL: very low, from a method that did not enumerate fibres at all
deep-sea microplastic abundance - UNDER THIS PROTOCOL, ON THE SAME SPLIT SAMPLES: substantially greater, with the other method shown to underestimate
discovery - as detecting that a relation exists, which the model does
discovery - as deciding which relation is worth stating, which stays with the mathematician
early activations - as the correlate of phenomenal consciousness, which is the currently favoured reading
early activations - as PRECONSCIOUS: information not yet conscious, which is the opposite reading of the same data

echo chamber effect - ON FACEBOOK AND TWITTER: strong correlation between a user's leaning and their neighbourhood's, communities spanning the spectrum but internally homogeneous, and diffusion biased toward like-minded peers
echo chamber effect - ON REDDIT AND GAB: absent. Users form a single community rather than opposed clusters, and the leaning of the influence set does not depend on the leaning of the seed
evidence of prebiotic activity - AS PRACTISED: increased abundance of bifidobacteria or lactobacilli
evidence of prebiotic activity - AS REQUIRED HERE: an assessment of the full microbial diversity in vivo, with pure and co-culture inference called inadequate
exosome - AS DEFINED HERE: a subtype of EV formed BY AN ENDOSOMAL ROUTE, typically 30-150 nm - the definition is by ORIGIN, and origin is not what any assay observes

exosome - A BIOGENESIS TERM, AND THE DOCUMENT'S CENTRAL CASE. It names EVs released via the multivesicular body. ISEV discourages it unless the population was actually separated and characterised, because no marker identifies it and no standard method enriches for it. `Balanced ANI Score` - `0.5 x (ANI score) + 0.5 x (quality score)`, the rule deciding when the genome a species name points at may be swapped

`benchmark` (GIAB sense) - a set of high-confidence calls published so that `ANYONE CAN BENCHMARK ACCURACY OF THEIR CALLS for these genomes`. Correctness distributed as a file, alongside the DNA it came from

`candidate species` - `a set of organisms identified as a putative new species`, in the paper's own glossary; named as `Hirudo medicinalis [Ca3 Siddall et al. 2007]`

`caseness` - not a clinical fact but a constructed standard: a dichotomised item-response-model score on the 12 surviving symptoms, cut at the point of `greatest agreement (kappa = 0.68)` with rater judgement
`category 3` - the level whose content IS the disagreement: `ANY LEVEL OF EVIDENCE, EVEN WHERE THERE IS SUBSTANTIAL DISAGREEMENT that the intervention is appropriate`

`CC1/2` - the correlation coefficient between two random half data sets; preferred because a correlation coefficient `HAS A WELL DEFINED RANGE`, and a descendant of Fourier shell correlation from 1980s electron microscopy

`Cell Theory` - A THEORY DEFINED AS THREE CONJOINED CLAIMS, TWO STRUCTURAL AND ONE HISTORICAL. `ALL ORGANISMS ARE COMPOSED OF ONE OR MORE CELLS; that CELLS ARE THE BASIC UNIT OF STRUCTURE AND FUNCTION IN LIFE; and that ALL CELLS ARE DERIVED FROM PRE-EXISTING CELLS.` The first two say what a thing IS MADE OF and what the parts DO; the third is a claim about ORIGIN and is the only one that could have been false without the others failing with it. **A citation to `Cell Theory` selects one of the three and the name records which no better than a coin.**

`character` - `any property or feature of the virus`, including genome composition, capsid structure, envelopment, gene expression programme, HOST RANGE, PATHOGENICITY and sequence similarity. AND ONE FAMILY OF CHARACTERS HAS WON: `sequence comparisons ... HAVE BECOME ONE OF THE PRIMARY SETS OF CHARACTERS used to define and distinguish virus taxa`

However, certain circRNAs ... suggest these species are PURPOSEFULLY PRODUCED`. Two senses of one term, in one sentence, separated by an abundance threshold

`common view` / `classical view` - THE FRAMEWORK THIS PAPER IS AGAINST HAS TWO NAMES, AND THE SECOND APPEARS EXACTLY ONCE: `a set of beliefs were refer to as THE COMMON VIEW (ALSO CALLED THE CLASSICAL VIEW)`. `content_tags.definitions[1]` already glosses `Common view`; **what was missing is that the literature this paper argues with calls it something else.** A reader searching the corpus for `classical view` - which is what the opposing literature calls itself - would not have reached this record.

`concept` (Deleuze and Guattari, adapted) - a multiplicity whose components are `distinct, heterogeneous and, yet, not separable`, and `there is NO CONCEPT WITH ONLY ONE COMPONENT`

`conventional agriculture` - DEFINED HISTORICALLY AND EXPLICITLY: growing crops in soil, in the open air, with irrigation and the active application of nutrients, pesticides and herbicides. A definition by PRACTICE rather than by yield or by certification, which is what makes the comparison well-posed

`crossover interaction` (EPIDEMIOLOGY) - the same effect-reversal ecology now calls `mitigating synergism`, and there it is `THE MOST STATISTICALLY ROBUST CLASS OF INTERACTION`

`crowded` AS AGAINST `concentrated` - TWO NAMES FOR ONE MILIEU, WITH THE CRITERION STATED: media are `KNOWN AS CROWDED RATHER THAN CONCENTRATED environments, as, IN GENERAL, NO INDIVIDUAL MACROMOLECULAR SPECIES MAY BE PRESENT AT HIGH CONCENTRATION`. High total, low per-species - and the second word would imply the opposite

`crowding agent` - A POLYMER STANDING IN FOR A CROWD, in the paper's own scare quotes: `concentrated solutions of various polymers that serve as MODEL CROWDING AGENTS`. A single-species concentrated solution used to model precisely the thing the paper distinguishes from a concentrated solution
`CTCAE` - the vocabulary that was `NCI-CTC version 2.0` until 2003, when it was `REVISED AND RENAMED the CTCAE version 3.0`. One instrument, two names, a date

`cultural competency` (Cross et al. 1989) - `a set of congruent behaviours, attitudes, and policies that come together in a system, agency, or among professionals` enabling effective work in cross-cultural situations

`cultural competency` (systems framing) - the ability of SYSTEMS to provide care to patients with diverse values, tailoring delivery to their needs
`cultural safety` (Nursing Council of NZ 1992) - `a focus for the delivery of quality care through changes in thinking about POWER RELATIONSHIPS and patients' rights`
`cultural safety` (this paper's proposal) - examined bias, ongoing self-reflection and accountability, `AS DEFINED BY THE PATIENT AND THEIR COMMUNITIES` and measured by progress towards health equity

`danger signal` - split into two by ORIGIN rather than by structure: `(a) DAMAGE-ASSOCIATE MOLECULAR PATTERNS (DAMPs), i.e., molecules released by stress cells undergoing necrosis` and `(b) PATHOGEN-ASSOCIATED MOLECULAR PATTERNS (PAMPs), which are pathogen-specific molecules NOT FOUND IN THE HOST`. The receptor cannot tell them apart; the definition is about where the molecule came from

`data quality` - HAS NO AGREED CRITERION IN THIS FIELD, which is the stated reason nothing is screened out: `THE LACK OF CONSENSUS WITHIN THE FUNCTIONAL IMAGING COMMUNITY ON CRITERIA FOR QUALITY ASSURANCE`
`data saturation` - informational redundancy, judged at the level of data collection and separated from analysis and from theory
`de novo OTU` - a cluster emergent from one data set, whose boundaries and membership depend on that data set and are undefined outside it

`detected`, AS OPERATIONALISED HERE - what survives a method that AVERAGES alignment quality instead of THRESHOLDING it. `A thousand published studies` used the thresholded algorithms and the class `HAD ELUDED DETECTION`
`Development environment` versus `Operational environment` - the pair that carries the generalisation claim: the settings the training data came from, against the settings the system is deployed into

`developmental` (this paper's sense) - `the condition EMERGES IN THE COURSE OF DEVELOPMENT, rather than being acquired or associated with a known biomedical cause`; NOT `the child might grow out of it` and NOT `unable to develop language`, both of which panel members read into it

`developmentally equivalent` - UNDEFINED BY THE FIELD AND FILLED BY CONVENTION: `THERE IS NO EXACT DEFINITION OF THE MINIMUM TIME for detecting developmental effects across scans, though designs TYPICALLY SPAN AT LEAST 3-6 MONTHS`

`digital transformation` AS A KIND - `a process of DEEP, STRUCTURAL CHANGE that occurs through the integration of multiple technologies and FUNDAMENTALLY REDEFINES ORGANIZATIONAL VALUE AND IDENTITY`. A third characterisation in the same paragraph as the other two

`digital transformation` AS DEFINED - `a process that AIMS TO IMPROVE AN ENTITY BY TRIGGERING SIGNIFICANT CHANGES TO ITS PROPERTIES THROUGH COMBINATIONS OF INFORMATION, COMPUTING, COMMUNICATION, AND CONNECTIVITY TECHNOLOGIES`. A definition with one hedge doing all the work - `SIGNIFICANT`

`digital transformation` AS DISTINGUISHED - not by kind but by three magnitudes: `in contrast to other forms of technological change, digital transformation DIFFERS IN TERMS OF ITS SCALE, SPEED, AND SCOPE`. The class boundary is three comparatives with no threshold
`Direct Parent` - the single most descriptive category; `most descriptive` is explicitly acknowledged to vary by user and context

`dissemination in time` (2010 sense) - satisfied EITHER by a new lesion on a later scan OR by enhancing and non-enhancing lesions coexisting on ONE baseline scan; the 2005 sense required a reference scan at least 30 days after onset

`domain adaptation` - AS STIPULATED HERE, because the field does not agree: `the process of ADAPTING ONE OR MORE SOURCE DOMAINS for the means of transferring information to improve the performance of a target learner`, by bringing the source's distribution closer to the target's.

term_head_mismatches.head: `Duke Excluded Regions` -> `ENCODE Data Analysis Center blacklisted regions`

examples.label: `Duke Excluded Regions` -> `ENCODE Data Analysis Center blacklisted regions` - THE SAME OBJECT UNDER TWO NAMES, three sentences apart, with both naming verbs present: `TERMED the Duke Excluded Regions (DER)` and `NOW REFERRED TO AS ENCODE Data Analysis Center (DAC) blacklisted regions`

term_head_mismatches.head: `early postoperative` IS AN ADMINISTRATIVE BOUNDARY, NOT A CLINICAL ONE: `generally indicates THE TIME FROM SURGERY TO THE FIRST HOSPITAL DISCHARGE`

examples.label: `early postoperative` IS AN ADMINISTRATIVE BOUNDARY, NOT A CLINICAL ONE: `generally indicates THE TIME FROM SURGERY TO THE FIRST HOSPITAL DISCHARGE` - and the paper adds `but in theory` the classification reaches past it, so the scope moves with discharge policy.
`effective publication` - the weaker condition that gets a name INTO the register without standing; it is `THE INCLUSION CRITERION` for LPSN, not for the code
`eMDSC` (early-stage MDSC) - replaces `immature MDSC`, because `SOME IMMATURITY IS A COMMON TRAIT OF ALL MDSC SUBSETS` and the modifier therefore discriminated nothing

`energy` here is DIRECT ENERGY ONLY - the study excludes energy embodied in chemical or material inputs, and excludes labour. The 82x ratio is a ratio of direct inputs, and the authors say a full life cycle assessment could produce alternative results
`entertainment` (2001) - one category holding both light and dark human interest; split here into entertainment and drama
`etiologic criterion` - why it happened; required for diagnosis, excluded from grading, and kept `to guide appropriate intervention and anticipated outcomes`

`EV mimetic` - A TERM CHOSEN TO STOP A NAME SMUGGLING IN A CLAIM: `This term is PREFERRED OVER ‘exosome‐like vesicles’ AND SIMILAR TERMS THAT IMPLY SPECIFIC BIOGENESIS‐RELATED PROPERTIES.` The rejected names are not wrong about what the particles ARE - they are wrong about what has been SHOWN. A name that asserts an unproven origin is treated here as a methodological fault, not a stylistic one.

`excluded volume effects` - `the thermodynamic consequences of the unavailable volume`, arising because `two molecules cannot be in the same place at the same time`. A named effect whose definition is a geometric impossibility

`exosome` - THE USAGE VERDICT, WHICH IS SEPARATE FROM THE MEANING THIS RECORD ALREADY CARRIES AT senses[1]: MISEV2023 grades it **`Discouraged unless subcellular origin can be demonstrated`**. NOT abolished and NOT redefined - PERMITTED ON A CONDITION, and the condition is evidential rather than semantic. The document runs a THREE-LEVEL SCALE - `Recommended`, `Recommended, but caution required`, `Discouraged unless ...` - so a nomenclature body here is grading terms by HOW MUCH EVIDENCE THEIR USE PRESUPPOSES, not by whether they are correct.
`exosome` BY PELLET - Table 4 gives ultracentrifugation at 100,000-150,000x g as the `GOLDEN STANDARD` yielding a `HIGHLY PURE EXOSOMAL FRACTION`. A third sense: whatever comes down at that speed

`exosome` BY ROUTE - `nano-sized biovesicles released into surrounding body fluids UPON FUSION OF MULTIVESICULAR BODIES AND THE PLASMA MEMBRANE`. A DEFINITION BY HISTORY: the property is where the vesicle came from, which cannot be read off the vesicle

`exosome` BY SIZE AND MARKERS - Table 1: `Size HOMOLOGOUS 30-100 nm`, markers `CD63, TSG101, Alix, flottilin`, density `1.13-1.19 g/mL`, against MV at 100-1000 nm and apoptotic bodies at 1-5 um. THE OPERATIONAL SENSE, and the one that can be applied to a tube

`exposure` (endemic mycoses) - `a history of residence in an endemic area, NO MATTER HOW REMOTE, travel to an endemic area, or contact with fomites such as soil or vegetation`. A criterion with no time limit at all

`extracellular vesicles` - THE 2023 DEFINITION, ALL THREE CLAUSES NEGATIVE OR STRUCTURAL AND NONE ABOUT ORIGIN: `particles that are RELEASED FROM CELLS, are DELIMITED BY A LIPID BILAYER, and CANNOT REPLICATE ON THEIR OWN`. Nothing about where in the cell they came from - which is the whole point of the accompanying deprecations.

`extremes` - LEFT UNDEFINED ON PURPOSE, AND THE BENCHMARK DROPS THE PHENOMENON RATHER THAN PICK A DEFINITION: `DEFINING EXTREMES IS AMBIGUOUS WHICH IS WHY THERE IS NO STANDARD METRIC for evaluating extremes ... we decided to OMIT EXTREMES FOR NOW but users are encouraged to chose their own verification`. THE AMBIGUITY IS UPSTREAM OF THE METRIC AND THE MISSING METRIC IS UPSTREAM OF THE BENCHMARK'S SCOPE - a definitional problem propagating into what a whole field will be measured on.
`fake news` - AS A TERM: possibly inadequate, since political debate often resorts to labelling opposite news as unreliable or fake

`false negative` - here NOT a property of the assay: an antibody-negative PCR-positive result can be immunocompromise, T-cell clearance, a bad sample, or a FALSE-POSITIVE PCR. Four alternatives to the instrument being wrong
`feasibility study` (NETSCC) - research done before a main study to estimate design parameters, which `CRUCIALLY ... DO NOT EVALUATE THE OUTCOME OF INTEREST`
`feasibility study` (this framework) - `ALL STUDIES AIMING TO ASSESS WHETHER A FUTURE RCT IS DO-ABLE`; asks whether something can be done, should we proceed, and if so how

`filler` - ONE WORD, TWO DISJOINT SENSES, IN ONE SENTENCE. `INERT FILLERS are materials that are used to modify the strength, working and flow properties, and shrinkage of plastics, WHILE the reinforcing ones, ALSO CALLED FILLERS, are defined as those with some strength properties that are SIGNIFICANTLY SUPERIOR to those of the base resin`. The second sense claims the bare word that the first also uses

`functionally similar` - `comparable molecular functions AND ... similar biological processes`, explicitly WITHOUT common ancestry: `did NOT NECESSARILY EVOLVE FROM A COMMON ANCESTOR and therefore DO NOT NECESSARILY SHOW SEQUENCE SIMILARITY`
`fuzzy species` - a species with one or more genomes at >=95% ANI to a genome in another species; 2.2% of those examined. The complement, `discrete`, is 89.5%
`gambling related harm` (New Zealand Gambling Act 2003) - `any kind of harm or distress arising from, or caused or EXACERBATED BY, a person's gambling`

`gambling related harm` (proposed here) - `Any initial or exacerbated adverse consequence due to an engagement with gambling that leads to A DECREMENT to the health or wellbeing of an individual, family unit, community or population`
`gambling related harm` (Queensland) - a `range of adverse consequences` in which safety or wellbeing is placed at risk, arising from PROBLEMATIC gambling only

term_head_mismatches.head: `GAN` = `Generative Adversarial Nets`, defined correctly in the body

examples.label: `GAN` = `Generative Adversarial Nets`, defined correctly in the body - `the newest DL technique NAMED Generative Adversarial Nets (GAN)` - and WRONGLY in the Abbreviations table as `AN`. The same identity, twice, one right and one not

`gestational diabetes` (concept) - `ANY DEGREE OF GLUCOSE INTOLERANCE WITH ONSET OR FIRST RECOGNITION DURING PREGNANCY`, and this part `IS LARGELY ACCEPTED`
`gestational diabetes` (IADPSG sense) - fasting >= 5.1, one hour >= 10.0, or two hours >= 8.5 mmol/L, derived from the HAPO study AND BASED ON PREGNANCY OUTCOMES rather than on a distribution

`gestational diabetes` (WHO sense) - the 2 h 75 g OGTT with the cut points used OUTSIDE pregnancy: fasting >= 7 mmol/l or 2 h plasma glucose >= 7.8 mmol/l, encompassing impaired glucose tolerance and diabetes

`GO annotation` - `AN ASSOCIATION BETWEEN A SPECIFIC GENE (or gene product) AND A GO TERM ... interpreted as A STATEMENT that the specified gene product possesses the specified functional characteristic`, and `EACH GO ANNOTATION INCLUDES THE EVIDENCE upon which it is based`. One claim, one evidence, one tag

`gold standard` (absent) - `NO CLEAR GOLD STANDARD EXISTS against which to assess these antibody tests`, and the substitute is explicitly a proxy: `RT-PCR positivity is A PROXY for the expected presence of antibody`

`good health` - OPERATIONALLY, EMPLOYABILITY PLUS AN ABSENCE OF RECORDS. `in good health, PERMITTING A FULL TIME JOB WITHOUT RESTRICTION`, with `NO INFORMATION ... ABOUT HABITS ... AND POSSIBLE COMORBIDITIES`. The second cohort uses a stricter sense - `carefully selected on the basis of THE ABSENCE OF ANY CHRONIC DISEASE OR SUBSTANCE/MEDICATIONS` - so the paper carries two senses of health and validates one against the other

`harm` - SLIDING BETWEEN THE CAUSE AND THE EFFECT: `the term harm is often USED INTERCHANGEABLY TO REFER TO THE BEHAVIOUR - NOT JUST THE CONSEQUENCE`. One word covering the gambling and the damage it does, which makes any claim that one produces the other unfalsifiable.
`harm` in ordinary use - `immediately intuitive, implying damage and adverse consequences`, and that intuitiveness is precisely why it went undefined

`head motion` - operationalised as framewise displacement, itself defined by a geometric convention: rotations are converted to distances `BASED ON THE CHANGES ACROSS THE SURFACE OF A 50 MM RADIUS SPHERE`

`health literacy` - DECLARED TO HAVE NO AGREED DEFINITION, AND THE CONSEQUENCE NAMED: `there is NO CONSENSUS ABOUT THE DEFINITION of health literacy or about its conceptual dimensions, WHICH LIMITS THE POSSIBILITIES FOR MEASUREMENT AND COMPARISON.` The absence is not reported as untidiness - it is reported as the thing preventing the field from measuring anything.

`health literacy` (this paper's synthesis) - `people's KNOWLEDGE, MOTIVATION AND COMPETENCES TO ACCESS, UNDERSTAND, APPRAISE, AND APPLY HEALTH INFORMATION` in healthcare, disease prevention and health promotion, across the life course

`Health outcome` and `Clinical outcome` - TWO GLOSSARY ENTRIES WITH ONE DEFINITION, differing only in `that` versus `which`. Either they are the same concept named twice, or a distinction the authors intended did not survive into the text
`healthy` (as operationalised here) - no pockets deeper than 3 mm and bleeding at no more than 10% of gingival sites, against a literature convention of `LESS THAN 20-25%`

`heavy metal` - THREE COMPETING DEFINITIONS IN FOUR SENTENCES, THE SECOND REFUTED BY ITS OWN EXTENSION: density `at least 5 g/cm-3`; OR `an atomic mass higher than 23 or an atomic number exceeding 20`; and then `THESE DEFINITIONS ARE CONFUSING AND MISLEADING DUE TO THE FACT THAT THEY CAUSE THE INCLUSION OF NON-METALS`
`high-abundance circRNA` - OPERATIONALLY, `5' CR>0.2; 3' CR>0.2; SRPBM>1`, which returns 990 of them. The sense is the inequality; nothing else defines the class

`high` (of a postoperative temperature) - `some surgeons INCLUDED A BODY TEMPERATURE GREATER THAN 38 C ON TWO CONSECUTIVE DAYS as being `high`, WHEREAS OTHERS` counted an entirely different set of events. The word survived; the referent did not
`highly similar` / `functionally related` / `not functionally similar` - three chosen bands on the simRel score: above 0.9, between 0.5 and 0.7, below 0.3
`horizontal pleiotropy` - a variant affecting the outcome through a pathway OTHER than the risk factor. `A VIOLATION OF THE INSTRUMENTAL VARIABLE ASSUMPTIONS`

`host factor` - `a characteristic of individuals CLEARLY PREDISPOSED TO, AND NOT SIMPLY AT RISK OF, an IFD`. Impaired gut wall integrity raises the risk of candidiasis and is refused as a host factor for not being specific enough

`ICTV` - the committee, which RENAMED ITSELF FROM NAMING TO CLASSIFYING: `established in 1966 as the International Committee on NOMENCLATURE of Viruses, and was RENAMED the International Committee on TAXONOMY of Viruses in 1977`

`ileus` / `small bowel obstruction` / `colon obstruction` - THREE REPORTING NAMES FOR ONE EVENT, and the paper's reason for existing: `under such circumstances, THE INCIDENCE OF THIS AE CANNOT BE COUNTED ACCURATELY`
`immune-related adverse event` - bounded by a reporting window that differs between studies, and with a class of late events that falls outside all of them
`implementation fidelity` - `the degree to which . . . programs are implemented . . . as intended by the program developers`, quoted with two elisions; `SOMETIMES ALSO TERMED `INTEGRITY``
`indel` - AND WHETHER A GIVEN ONE IS AN INSERTION OR A DELETION DEPENDS ON THE ALIGNER: `BWA ANNOTATES INDELS PREFERENTIALLY AS DELETIONS, AND GraphMap FAVORS INSERTIONS`

`inductive` / `transductive` - the split is defined by WHAT THE METHOD RETURNS, not by how it works: `the former attempt to find a CLASSIFICATION MODEL, whereas the latter are solely concerned with obtaining LABEL PREDICTIONS for the given unlabelled data points`.

term_head_mismatches.head: `inflammation phase` AS THE BODY USES IT

examples.label: `inflammation phase` AS THE BODY USES IT - `CONCURRENT WITH HAEMOSTASIS`, lasting `2-5 days`, and named for a response that `CONTINUES THROUGH THE WHOLE PROCEDURE OF WOUND HEALING`. Concurrent with the phase before it, overlapping the phase after it, and outlived by its own defining property

`instrumental variable` - `variables that are associated with the risk factor of interest, that are NOT RELATED TO CONFOUNDERS, and that AFFECT THE OUTCOME ONLY THROUGH THE RISK FACTOR`; need not be genetic
`integration by congruence` - species limits at the INTERSECTION of two or more independent characters. Stringent; risks beta error, false negatives, and a bias toward old species
`integration by cumulation` - species limits from divergence in ONE OR MORE not necessarily overlapping characters. Permissive; risks alpha error, false positives, and taxonomic inflation
`internal consistency` - agreement among symmetry-related observations, which `LIKELY UNDERESTIMATES THE TRUE ERROR` because those observations share their systematic errors

`intrinsic functional connectivity` - operationalised down to a coordinate and a diameter: `the mean time series from a SPHERICAL REGION OF INTEREST (DIAMETER=8 MM) CENTERED IN PCC` and `Pearson's correlation ... Fisher r-to-z transformed`

`IRES` / `cap-independent translation` - A MECHANISM NAMED IN VIRUSES AND THEN CARRIED INTO CELL BIOLOGY. `Cap-independent translation, driven by THE SO-CALLED IRES, WAS INITIALLY DESCRIBED IN VIRAL RNAs (Pelletier and Sonenberg, 1988) AND SUBSEQUENTLY IDENTIFIED ALSO IN CELLULAR RNAs.` **`so-called` is the paper keeping its distance from the name while using it**, and the sentence records the term's migration between two literatures in the order it happened. `language disorder` (this paper) - problems `LIKELY TO ENDURE INTO MIDDLE CHILDHOOD AND BEYOND, WITH A SIGNIFICANT IMPACT on everyday social interactions or educational progress`; defined by PROGNOSIS and FUNCTION, explicitly not by a test cut-off and not by a verbal/nonverbal discrepancy

`late or selective vaccinator` - THE ONLY POSITION DEFINED BY WHAT THE PARENT DOES RATHER THAN BELIEVES: `Concerns about vaccination result in this group CHOOSING TO DELAY OR SELECT ONLY SOME recommended vaccines`. And it is porous - `With a specific vaccine scare hesitant parents may SELECT-OUT the vaccine and MOVE TO THIS CATEGORY`
`legacy harm` - harm that continues or emerges after engagement with gambling ceases; the label exists to mark that harm does not end with the behaviour
`literacy` (the head noun) - `FAMILIAR WITH LITERATURE` or `WELL EDUCATED, LEARNED` for most of its history, and only in the late nineteenth century `THE ABILITIES TO READ AND WRITE TEXT`

`local chemical potential` - DEFINED OUTRIGHT AND WITH THE VERB: `In the context of DTNN, WE DEFINE a local chemical potential as AN ENERGY OF A CERTAIN ATOM TYPE A, LOCATED AT A POSITION r IN THE MOLECULE M` - with the probe allowed to feel the molecule and forbidden to act on it

`low-quality cell` - OPERATIONALLY, WHATEVER THE OUTLIER DETECTOR MARKS. The paper gives examples (`low total counts and few expressed genes`) and then says the method is `SOMEWHAT OPAQUE WITH RESPECT TO HOW OUTLIERS ARE DEFINED`. A class defined by its detector, with the detector declining to say what it detects

examples.label: `low-quality cell` IN THE OTHER SENSE THE SAME PAPER USES - A CELL THAT DIED OR WHOSE PROTOCOL FAILED: `a high percentage of counts mapping to spike-ins typically indicates that a small amount of RNA was captured for the cell, SUGGESTING PROTOCOL FAILURE OR DEATH OF THE CELL`.
