`macrosomia` - `AS DEFINED BY THE AUTHORS`, which in practice is birth weight above 4000 g in four of five studies and something else in the fifth
`magnitude` - large numbers of people or potential impact (2001), widened here to include extreme behaviour or occurrence

`malnutrition` (GLIM) - at least ONE phenotypic criterion (weight loss, low BMI, reduced muscle mass) AND at least ONE etiologic criterion (reduced intake or assimilation, inflammation or disease burden)

`margin` - ONE TERM, TWO DIFFERENT KINDS OF OBJECT, AND THE SURVEY RECORDS BOTH WITHOUT CHOOSING: `the _margin_, WHICH IS DEFINED AS THE DISTANCE between the decision boundary and the data points closest to it. THE TERM IS ALSO COMMONLY USED TO DESCRIBE THE AREA extruding from the decision boundary in which no data points lie.` A SCALAR AND A REGION. Not two readings of one quantity - two different types, so `maximise the margin` and `lies within the margin` are grammatical with different referents, and only one of them can be a number. This record already carries a declared type error kept on purpose at `senses[3]` and two senses of `abuse of notation` at `senses[4]`; this is the same survey's third type-level observation, and the only one it does not flag as its own.

`marker gene set` - A SET-THEORETIC DEFINITION WHERE THE FIELD USUALLY HAS A BIOLOGICAL INTUITION: `a set of genes that are ALL EXPRESSED IN A GIVEN CLUSTER, BUT NOT ALL EXPRESSED IN ANY OTHER CLUSTER`. The definition is about the SET, not about any gene in it - no single gene need be unique to the cluster.
`MDSC` (2007 coinage) - a term chosen for `THE MYELOID ORIGIN, THE IMMUNE-SUPPRESSIVE FUNCTION AND THE SYSTEMIC EXPANSION`, explicitly NOT a claim about a distinct lineage
`medical` / `patient` / `clinical health literacy` - three names for the individual cognitive-skills tradition, framed by Nutbeam as a `CLINICAL RISK` approach
`metagenome` - `a collection of genomes and genes from the members of a microbiota`, and the term `microbiome` is `SOMETIMES CONFUSED` with it

`microbiome` (Lederberg, THE MOST CITED) - `a community of commensal, symbiotic, and pathogenic microorganisms WITHIN A BODY SPACE OR OTHER ENVIRONMENT` - ecological, host-centred, and not the original

`microbiome` (method-driven family) - `A COLLECTIVE GENOME of microorganisms in a specific environment`, the family whose bottleneck is that `EVERY NEW AVAILABLE TECHNOLOGY WILL RESULT IN A NEED FOR A NEW DEFINITION`

`microbiome` (Whipps et al. 1988, revived here) - `a CHARACTERISTIC MICROBIAL COMMUNITY occupying a reasonable well-defined habitat which has DISTINCT PHYSIO-CHEMICAL PROPERTIES ... not only refers to the microorganisms involved but also ENCOMPASS THEIR THEATRE OF ACTIVITY`
`microbiota` - `the ASSEMBLAGE OF LIVING MICROORGANISMS present in a defined environment`; phages, viruses, plasmids, prions, viroids and free DNA are IN the microbiome and NOT IN the microbiota

`Microvesicle` - A TERM RETIRED FOR THE OPPOSITE OF VAGUENESS: IT MEANS SOMETHING PRECISE AND NOBODY USED IT THAT WAY. `Microvesicle BIOGENESIS-RELATED TERM INDICATING ORIGIN FROM THE PLASMA MEMBRANE. HOWEVER, HISTORICALLY, THE TERM HAS OFTEN BEEN USED TO DESIGNATE LARGE EVs OR ALL EVs, WHATEVER THEIR SUBCELLULAR ORIGIN. This term can therefore lead to confusion. DISCOURAGED.` **The definition is not in dispute; the usage diverged from it and the consortium retires the word rather than the definition.** Compare `thery2018`, which retired the same term for a DIFFERENT stated fault - `manifold, contradictory definitions` AND `inaccurate expectations of unique biogenesis`. **Two consortium documents, five years apart, retire one word and give different reasons for it.**

`miRNA sponging` - A MECHANISM THAT WAS OVER-GENERALISED FROM ITS FIRST CASES, AND THE FIELD SAYS SO. `genome-wide studies have demonstrated that MIRNA SPONGING ACTIVITY CANNOT BE GENERALLY APPLIED ... and other mechanisms have also been proposed.` The term is not wrong; its SCOPE was. **This is a definitional correction that leaves the word intact and changes what it may be said of** - the failure mode mechanism 28 describes, arriving from genome-wide data rather than from argument.
`misclassification` - contested in this paper: an assignment the expert panel rejects may still be correct under the criterion the classifier declares

`mitigating synergism` (new here) - `two stressors operating in the same direction create a cumulative effect COMPLETELY OPPOSITE to what would have been predicted`: two positives make a negative, or two negatives make a positive
`monosemic reference` - a term distinguished from a general-language word by its single-meaning relationship with the concept it designates, and by the stability of that relationship in texts

`more aromatic` - AROMATICITY USED AS A SCALAR, IN SCARE QUOTES. `the DTNN model predicts the C6O3H6 molecule to be MORE AROMATIC than benzene or toluene`, and the paper reports the model grasps `DIFFERENT DEGREES OF AROMATICITY`. A property usually taught as a yes/no becomes a ranking because the model produces one

`MR Egger regression` - allows pleiotropic effects `AS LONG AS THE SIZE OF THESE PLEIOTROPIC EFFECTS IS INDEPENDENT OF THE SIZE OF THE GENETIC VARIANTS' EFFECTS ON THE RISK FACTOR` - a violation permitted under a condition

`naturally` - A WORD DELETED FROM A DEFINITION AND THE DELETION MINUTED. MISEV2018 said EVs are `naturally released`; MISEV2023 removes it so engineered EVs are not excluded by accident. A field editing its category boundary in public and saying why

`negative for pneumonia` - `NO PARENCHYMAL ABNORMALITIES THAT COULD BE ATTRIBUTABLE TO INFECTION. Specifically, GGO AND CONSOLIDATION ARE ABSENT` - and immediately: `THERE MAY BE NO FINDINGS ON CT EARLY IN COVID-19`
`neutralizing activity` - measured two ways that do not agree: a cell-culture neutralization assay and an RBD-ACE2 blocking assay, the latter `LESS SENSITIVE` for named mechanistic reasons
`news values` - as the field defines them: a taxonomy of selection criteria identifiable in published output, offered as a tool rather than an explanation
`news` - as practitioners define it: `I know it when I see it`, `Because it just is!`, a gut feeling that obscures as much as it reveals

`NLR` - `THE ABSOLUTE NEUTROPHIL COUNT WAS DIVIDED BY THE ABSOLUTE LYMPHOCYTE COUNT TO CALCULATE THE NLR`. One sentence, one division, and no cue list the gate holds can see it - `calculated as` is on MEASUREMENT and `to calculate` is not

`no harmony` - the paper's verdict on the attempts to reconcile them: `MUCH OF THE SUBSEQUENT CONVERSATION consisted of either trying to HARMONIZE these definitions ... or ASSERTING THAT ONE OR THE OTHER IS CORRECT. AS IT TURNS OUT, THERE CAN BE NO HARMONY among definitions in a world where inequality and imperfect prediction are the reality`
`nomenclatural type` - `THE ENTITY WITH WHICH A TAXON NAME IS PERMANENTLY ASSOCIATED`; for prokaryotes a living type STRAIN, and an attempt to admit a genome sequence instead was rejected

`normal value` - IN THIS PAPER, THE MEAN +/- 1.96 SD OF A WORKING POPULATION, 0.78 to 3.53. Not a physiological threshold, not an outcome-derived cut-off: a distribution of people who were at work and had blood taken

term_head_mismatches.head: `normal value` IN THE LITERATURE IT CORRECTS

examples.label: `normal value` IN THE LITERATURE IT CORRECTS - `THE MEDIAN, HIGHER QUARTILE OR VALUES DETERMINED BY THE USE OF RECEIVER-OPERATING CURVES`, computed inside the diseased sample. THE SAME PHRASE NAMES A PROPERTY OF THE HEALTHY IN ONE PLACE AND A PROPERTY OF THE SICK IN THE OTHER

`obsoleted` - RETIRED BUT NOT DELETED, on three stated grounds: `Terms may be obsoleted WHEN UNUSED OR INCONSISTENTLY USED IN ANNOTATION, when they are REDUNDANT with other terms, or DURING REVISION OF SPECIFIC BRANCHES`. Plus two more the paper demonstrates: an ungrounded retraction, and being beyond the ontology's scope
`operational taxonomic unit` - a cluster of reads below a fixed dissimilarity threshold, most commonly 3%; the customary unit of marker-gene analysis
`opticospinal MS` - a regionally used term that `APPEARS TO BE AN ADMIXTURE OF CONVENTIONAL MS AND NMO` rather than a class of its own

`optimal` spacer length - AS USED HERE, TWICE OVER. In principle a derived quantity (epitope position, steric hindrance); in practice an empirical one, tailored per pair. THE PAPER'S OWN SCARE QUOTES MARK THE GAP - a property defined by a theory and decided by trying it
`organic` - in ChemOnt, containing one or more carbon atoms, with a short enumerated exception list rather than a principle

`other (specify)` - THE OPEN SLOT THE CONTROLLED VOCABULARY SHIPS WITH: `If no applicable AE terms are found in the JCOG PC criteria, `other (specify)` SHOULD BE CHOSEN`, after which the general Clavien-Dindo rules apply

`panacea` - the title's word and the paper's own hedge against it. The body says EdTech `CANNOT REPLACE A TEACHER BUT IT CAN ENHANCE INSTRUCTION`, which is the opposite of a panacea claim, and the title is the part that gets cited

`pancreatic fistula` (CTCAE 4.0 sense) - graded by a definition that `is SUITABLE FOR PANCREATITIS, BUT NOT FOR PANCREATIC FISTULA AFTER PANCREATECTOMY`. The term is in the vocabulary and its criteria belong to a different condition

`pathological activation` - the state that separates MDSC from monocytes and neutrophils: persistent low-strength stimulation, poor phagocytosis, high ROS/RNS and anti-inflammatory cytokines, against short-lived CLASSICAL activation
`PD-L1 positive` - TWO SCORES AND THREE CUT POINTS: `>= 50% tumor proportion score` in the European approval, `combined positive score >= 1` in the FDA approval

`Performance error` - DEFINED AS DELIBERATELY UNDEFINED: `it is up to the INVESTIGATOR to specify what should be considered a performance error, preferably based on prior evidence`. The vocabulary names the slot and refuses to fill it

`phase` IN THE PARTITION - a named interval with a numeric range: haemostasis (0-several hours), inflammation (1-3 days), proliferation (4-21 days), remodelling (21 days-1 year). FOUR RANGES THAT DO NOT OVERLAP AS PRINTED, under the word `OVERLAPPING`
`phenotypic criterion` - what the body shows; the only half used for severity grading into Stage 1 (moderate) and Stage 2 (severe)

`physical coverage` - the substituted metric: `the number of inferred fragments that cover a particular genomic position (INCLUDING BOTH THE SEQUENCED ENDS AS WELL AS THE UNSEQUENCED GENOMIC REGION BETWEEN THE ENDS)`. It counts territory the instrument never read

`physical inactivity` - the term the 2012 letter existed to separate from `sedentary behaviour`, EXEMPTED from the 2017 vote because nobody proposed a change, and still the MeSH heading used in its place

term_head_mismatches.head: `physiological conditions` AS THE FIELD USES IT

examples.label: `physiological conditions` AS THE FIELD USES IT - A DILUTE BUFFER. `the SO-CALLED physiological conditions used in the vast majority of in vitro experiments where studies are conducted under the RELATIVELY IDEAL THERMODYNAMIC CONDITIONS OF LOW PROTEIN AND MODERATE SALT CONCENTRATIONS`. The scare quotes are the authors'

`pilot study` (NETSCC, recommended here) - `A VERSION OF THE MAIN STUDY THAT IS RUN IN MINIATURE to test whether the components of the main study can all work together`; internal if its data join the final analysis, external if set aside

`pilot study` (NIHR) - `a SMALLER VERSION OF THE MAIN STUDY used to test whether the components of the main study can all work together`; contrasted in the same paragraph with MRC's `NEED NOT BE A SCALE MODEL`
`pilot study` (Thabane 2010) - `SYNONYMOUS WITH a feasibility study intended to guide the planning of a large scale investigation`, the position this framework replaces
`pilot study` (this framework) - the same questions PLUS a design feature: a future study or part of one is conducted ON A SMALLER SCALE. A subset of feasibility studies, not its complement

`pilot study` / `feasibility study` - SYNONYMOUS TO ONE BODY AND MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE TO ANOTHER, AT THE SAME TIME. Thabane (2010): `a pilot study is SYNONYMOUS WITH a feasibility study`. NIHR, `at about the same time`: definitions `THAT ARE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE`, with feasibility earlier in the process and a pilot `a version of the main study that is RUN IN MINIATURE`. The same two terms, the same years, opposite relations.
`pilot work` / `pilot study` / `pilot trial` (Arnold et al) - a three-way split: any background research, a study with hypotheses and methodology, and a stand-alone pilot study with randomisation

`pilot` (the label, as authors use it) - reached for when a study `DOES NOT HAVE THE POWER to test clinically meaningful hypotheses`, in the hope that reviewers `WILL REGARD A `PILOT` MORE FAVOURABLY THAN A SMALL CLINICAL TRIAL`
`placeholder name` - an alphanumeric string standing in for a Latin name, carried by 77.0% of GTDB species clusters and never replaced by another placeholder
`plant disease` OPERATIONALLY - WHATEVER IS IN PlantVillage: `54,306 images of 14 different crops having 26 plant diseases`. The class has 26 members because the benchmark has 26 folders

`plastic particles` - A TERM THE AUTHORS COIN FOR THEIR OWN USE, because the field's two names will not hold still: `TO CIRCUMVENT THE AMBIGUITY of the terms microplastic and nanoplastic particles in this article WE WILL REFER TO plastic particles AND WHERE APPROPRIATE DEFINE THE SIZE OR SIZE RANGE`. The remedy for an unstable term is to stop using it and carry the number instead

`Plasticene` - A GEOLOGICAL EPOCH PROPOSED FROM AN ARTEFACT CLASS. Plastics as `TECHNOFOSSILS` that `will constitute a perennial proof of the existence of humans on Earth`, with 1945 as the stratigraphic marker
`PMN-MDSC` - replaces `granulocytic MDSC` because the cells are `PHENOTYPICALLY DISTINCT FROM steady-state neutrophils` in six named ways

`polypharmacy` - DECLARED TO HAVE NO AGREED MEANING, IN THE ABSTRACT OF A REVIEW ABOUT ITS MEANINGS: `Despite this, THERE IS NO CONSENSUS DEFINITION FOR POLYPHARMACY. A systematic review was conducted to IDENTIFY AND SUMMARISE POLYPHARMACY DEFINITIONS in existing literature.` The absence of a definition is the paper's stated reason to exist.

`polypharmacy` (descriptive, 8.7%) - `more drugs being prescribed or taken than are clinically appropriate in the context of a patient's comorbidities`, and at the other extreme `PATIENTS VISITING MULTIPLE PHARMACIES to obtain medications` - a different referent entirely

`polypharmacy` (numerical with duration or setting, 10.9%) - the same counts qualified by a period or a place, e.g. five or more at hospital discharge; `IT DID NOT PROVIDE ANY FURTHER CLARITY OR CONSISTENCY`
`polypharmacy` (numerical, 80.4% of definitions) - a count of medications, threshold anywhere from TWO OR MORE to ELEVEN OR MORE; five or more in 46.4% of studies
`possible` IFD - a host factor and a clinical feature with the mycology missing. The category that `attracted controversy` where the other two did not - **defined by an absent measurement**
`potentiation` / `sensitization` (TOXICOLOGY) - the same one-sided interaction ecology would call synergism; Chou (2010) holds it is `NOT A TRUE SYNERGISM` because the modes of action differ
`present` (of a symptom) - `rated 4 or 5` on a five-point severity scale; `1, 2, or 3` is absent. The whole apparatus above this line runs on binary items

term_head_mismatches.head: `priming susceptibility` as a construct in its own right

examples.label: `priming susceptibility` as a construct in its own right - the paper measures not the effect but the OPENNESS to it, which is what allows an instruction to be the independent variable and priming to be the dependent one. Most records in this corpus put priming on the causal side; here it is the thing being caused to happen or not

`principle proliferation` - THE CONDITION THIS PAPER NAMES AND TREATS. Either the sets are similar, `leading to UNNECESSARY REPETITION AND REDUNDANCY`, or they differ, and `CONFUSION AND AMBIGUITY will result instead`. The worst case is named too: a `MARKET FOR PRINCIPLES` in which stakeholders `SHOP` for the most appealing

`probable` IFD - a host factor AND a clinical feature AND mycological evidence, `proposed for immunocompromised patients only, except for endemic mycoses`. **Expanded in this revision without changing the word**
`programme differentiation` - retired from the concept: it `ACTUALLY MEASURES SOMETHING DISTINCT FROM FIDELITY` and is renamed `identification of an intervention's essential components`

`proven` IFD - histology, culture or a sterile-site specimen. `Can apply to ANY patient, regardless of whether the patient is immunocompromised` - the only one of the three categories that is not restricted by host

`pseudo-labelled data` - A NAME WHOSE PREFIX CARRIES THE ONLY WARNING. `previously unlabelled data that is AUGMENTED WITH PREDICTIONS FROM EARLIER ITERATIONS OF THE LEARNERS. THE LATTER IS COMMONLY REFERRED TO AS _PSEUDO-LABELLED DATA_.` **`pseudo-` is doing all the epistemic work**: the data is treated exactly like labelled data by the algorithm, and only the name records that the labels are the model's own guesses. Drop the prefix in a citation and the caution is gone with it.
`pseudopolypharmacy` - `patients being RECORDED as taking more medications than they are ACTUALLY taking`: the record, not the patient

`pseudoprogression` - A TERM RETIRED BY VOTE, AND THE VOTE SHARE IS PRINTED: 94.1% agreed it `should be avoided in a setting of worsening symptoms`. NOT a redefinition and NOT a correction - a recommendation to stop applying the word in one setting, leaving it live everywhere else. THE CORPUS HAS FEW DEPRECATIONS AND FEWER WITH A DENOMINATOR.

`psychological antecedents of vaccination` - the fourth name in this record for the territory, taken from Brewer's review, and the one the instrument is titled after. hesitancy / confidence / acceptance / antecedents, in one paper
`public health literacy` - the population tradition, framed as a `PERSONAL ASSET` approach and rooted in adult learning and health promotion rather than clinical care

`quality control` HERE - NOT A FIXED PROCEDURE BUT AN INTERACTIVE ONE: `a single processing pipeline WITH FIXED PARAMETERS IS UNLIKELY TO BE UNIVERSALLY APPLICABLE ... allows PARAMETERS TO BE FINE-TUNED FOR THE STUDY AT HAND`
`R_merge` vs `R_meas` vs `R_p.i.m.` - three R factors for one property, the first of which RISES as the data improves

`radiologically isolated syndrome` - MS-appearing lesions found incidentally, for which `A FIRM DIAGNOSIS OF MS BASED ON INCIDENTAL FINDINGS ON MRI ALONE ... IS PROBLEMATIC`; the imaging is present and the diagnosis is withheld
`rank normalized` - higher ranks set by relative evolutionary divergence so that a genus in one phylum is comparable with a genus in another
`Reference Material` - NOT A SAMPLE BUT A SCALE: `often THE SOURCE OF THE SCALES ON WHICH WE REPORT OUR RESULTS ... a PHYSICAL REALIZATION OF THE SI UNITS`. The unit of measurement, made of DNA
`Regional Homogeneity (ReHo)` - `the SYNCHRONICITY of a voxel's time series and that of its NEAREST NEIGHBORS based on KENDALL'S COEFFICIENT OF CONCORDANCE`. A neighbourhood, a statistic, and a name

`resilience` - THREE TYPES IN ONE PARAGRAPH: `individual resilience is BOTH A PERSONALITY TRAIT AND A CAPACITY that can be developed`, and `recent evidence suggests that resilience MIGHT BE BETTER CONCEPTUALIZED AS A DEVELOPMENTAL PROCESS`
`resolution` (of a data set) - `A DIFFICULT AND POSSIBLY CONTENTIOUS QUESTION (PARTICULARLY WITH REFEREES OF PAPERS)`, with no definite rule because it `DEPENDS ON WHAT THE DATA ARE TO BE USED FOR`

`reviewed` vs `unreviewed` - A PROVENANCE TIER: reviewed entries carry data added `BY OUR EXPERT BIOCURATION TEAM`, unreviewed ones are `ANNOTATED BY AUTOMATED SYSTEMS`. The same field in both, with a different warrant behind it

`RIFLE` - three levels of renal dysfunction PLUS two clinical outcomes, `SEPARATED TO ACKNOWLEDGE THE IMPORTANT ADAPTATIONS THAT OCCUR IN ESRD THAT ARE NOT SEEN IN PERSISTENT ARF`. Loss is RRT for more than 4 weeks; ESRD is dialysis for more than 3 months
`saturation` - four incompatible readings in one literature: a theoretical category fully developed, no new codes appearing, pre-set codes exemplified, or data repeating themselves
`saturation` as a PROCESS - a matter of degree, an ongoing cumulative judgement that is perhaps never completed
`saturation` as an EVENT - a point that can be recognised and reported

`sedentary behavior` (as used in the literature) - a MET ceiling of <=1.5 in most papers, **<2.0 in one**, 1.0-1.8 in another, and no number at all in three (`non-upright activities`; `time spent sitting or lying`)

`sedentary behavior` (SBRN 2012, carried into 2017) - `ANY WAKING BEHAVIOUR CHARACTERIZED BY AN ENERGY EXPENDITURE <=1.5 METs WHILE IN A SITTING OR RECLINING POSTURE` - 558 Scopus citations by March 2017
`sedentary bout` / `sedentary break` - terms whose OPERATIONAL definitions vary, and the variation changes their measured association with health indicators

`semi-supervised learning works` - AS THE SURVEY IS FORCED TO QUALIFY IT: it can help, it can do nothing, and it can DEGRADE performance, with no way to know which in advance. The literature's record of the third case is described as UNDER-REPORTED

`semi-supervised transfer learning` - GONG AND BLITZER'S SENSE: `abundant labeled source data and LIMITED labeled target data`. THAT IS THE CONFIGURATION Daume and Chattopadhyay CALL SUPERVISED - see senses[4] and the `daume` mechanism on this record, which quote their sentence. One name over two configurations and one configuration under two names, in consecutive sentences.

`sensitivity` (manufacturer sense) vs `sensitivity` (ROC-optimised sense) - the same word for two numbers on the same machine and the same samples. Abbott is 92.7% under one and at least 98% under the other
`seropositive` - a status that DECAYS, so `seroprevalence studies MAY, OVER TIME, UNDERESTIMATE the proportion ... previously infected`. The label expires while the history does not

`sets` - A DECLARED TYPE ERROR, KEPT ON PURPOSE: `the collections of data points referred to here are TECHNICALLY LISTS. However, FOLLOWING COMMON USAGE, in this survey, we refer to them as ‘sets’ and, IN A SLIGHT ABUSE OF NOTATION, apply standard set-theoretic concepts to them.` The authors know the word is wrong, say so in a footnote, and use it anyway because the field does.

term_head_mismatches.head: `severity` IS OPERATIONALISED AS TREATMENT INTENSITY. Grade I is `Any deviation from the normal postoperative course WITHOUT THE NEED FOR pharmacological treatment or surgical, endoscopic, or radiological interventions`

examples.label: `severity` IS OPERATIONALISED AS TREATMENT INTENSITY. Grade I is `Any deviation from the normal postoperative course WITHOUT THE NEED FOR pharmacological treatment or surgical, endoscopic, or radiological interventions` - defined by what is NOT required. A patient who suffers greatly and needs nothing is grade I.
`shareability` - likely to generate sharing and comment; `stuff that makes you laugh and stuff that makes you angry` is the closest the paper gets to a definition
`sim Rel` - a score in [0,1] that DOES NOT REACH 1 FOR A TERM AGAINST ITSELF (0.99993 for `biotin biosynthesis`), because it is a function of the term's probability rather than of the pair alone

`size` and `diameter` - USED INTERCHANGEABLY ACROSS INSTRUMENTS THAT DERIVE THEM DIFFERENTLY: `While ‘size’ and ‘diameter’ are often used interchangeably BETWEEN MEASUREMENT METHODOLOGIES, THE WAY IN WHICH THEY ARE DERIVED CAN ALSO RESULT IN CONSISTENT DIFFERENCES IN MEASUREMENT TECHNIQUES`. The words are traded as equivalent while the instruments behind them are not.
`skeletal framework` (Morse et al.) - characteristics from previous inquiry giving an internal structure and a starting point, which multidisciplinary phenomena usually do not even have
`SLCN` - a superordinate category recommended FOR POLICYMAKERS AND SERVICE PLANNERS ONLY, and disclaimed for researchers, for parents and for treatment planning in the same paragraph

`species-level phylotype` - `OTUs CLUSTERING SEQUENCES AT A 3% GENETIC DIFFERENCE` in the V5-V6 region only, a convention the authors adopt for comparability while saying it `MAY NOT CORRELATE EXACTLY` with 3% over the whole gene
`species` (GTDB sense) - a cluster around a single representative genome, entered by ANI and alignment fraction to that representative; NOT a claim about a discontinuity in nature

`specific` (in Specific Language Impairment) - a modifier the panel abolished rather than redefined, because it `HAD CONNOTATIONS THAT WERE MISLEADING AND CONFUSING` and because the discrepancy reading it invited was `DISCREDITED`

`specific` scales - rejected as the route because they are `CLOSELY BOUND TO SPECIFIC TEMPORAL AND GEOGRAPHICAL CONTEXTS`, with a worked reason: the BCTI's New World Order item is not equally familiar in every country. THE INSTRUMENT'S REACH IS A PROPERTY OF ITS ITEMS' CULTURAL CURRENCY

`specificity` (of a GO term) - NOT depth in the graph: `DIFFERENT TERMS ON THE SAME RANK ... USUALLY ARE NOT EQUALLY SPECIFIC`. Operationalised instead as information content, i.e. how rarely the term is used
`SPIRIT-AI` - AS PRINTED IN THE GLOSSARY, THE DEFINITION OF `SPIRIT-AI extension item`, not of the initiative. The correct term is absent from the paper entirely

`SRPBM` - `spliced reads per billion mapping`, and the sense IS the formula: `SRPBM=number of circular reads/number of mapped reads (units in billion)/read length`. A unit invented so two RNA-seq runs can be compared at all

`standard t-SNE` - A NAME CREATED BY THE ARRIVAL OF ITS RIVAL. `a modified t-SNE algorithm WE CALL GRAPH T-SNE (gt-SNE). IN CONTRAST TO STANDARD T-SNE, which is based on distance measures`. Nobody called it `standard` t-SNE until this sentence needed to; the qualifier is retro-applied to the unmarked case in the act of marking the new one.
`standardization` - the founding objective of the discipline, and in socioterminology `a chimera since language is in constant change`

`stressor` (this paper) - `a variable that, AS A RESULT OF HUMAN ACTIVITY, EXCEEDS ITS RANGE OF NORMAL VARIATION and affects (WHETHER NEGATIVELY OR POSITIVELY) individual taxa, community composition, or ecosystem functioning relative to a reference condition` - against the prior usage as a synonym for pollution

`subspecies` - `infraspecific Linnaean category sometimes used to classify allopatric or parapatric populations showing SOME DEGREE OF DIVERGENCE ... NOT CONSIDERED LARGE ENOUGH FOR THE SPECIES RANK`. A rank defined by a quantity nobody specifies

`supervised transfer learning` - DAUME AND CHATTOPADHYAY'S SENSE: `abundant labeled source data and LIMITED labeled target data`. Gong and Blitzer give that same configuration to SEMI-SUPERVISED, and Cook and Feuz call it INFORMED SUPERVISED.

`supervised` / `unsupervised` - COOK AND FEUZ MOVE THE AXIS: the pair refers to `the presence or absence of labeled data IN THE SOURCE domain` and a SECOND pair, `informed` / `uninformed`, carries the target. Two orthogonal axes where the other schemes have one.

`synergism` (Crain et al. 2008, opposing stressors) - synergy `ONLY OCCURS WHEN THE CUMULATIVE EFFECT IS MORE NEGATIVE than the additive sum of the opposing individual effects` - which makes positive synergism unnameable and therefore uncountable

`synergism` (prevailing ecological sense) - `a cumulative effect of multiple stressors that are GREATER THAN THE ADDITIVE SUM of effects produced by the stressors acting in isolation`, with `antagonism` for less than additive
`synonym` - in ChemOnt a scoped relation, not an equality: exact, narrow, broad, or related when none of the three fits
`taxonomic change` - AN ENUMERATED TYPE WITH SIX VALUES: `new, split, move, merge, rename, and abolish`. Not prose, not a convention - a controlled field in a SQL schema, stored per taxon per release
`taxonomy` - a hierarchical scheme limited to one domain and ONE relationship type, as this paper uses it against `ontology`
`taxonomy` AS A DISCIPLINE - `This process of CLASSIFICATION AND NAMING comprises the discipline of taxonomy`. Two acts, one discipline, and the ICTV is unusual in holding authority over both
`terminological knowledge base` (Meyer) - a term bank whose concepts and designations are linked by meaningful relationships, not only generic-specific and part-whole
`terminology` (small t) - the units in any specialized knowledge field; `Terminology` (capital T) - the study of specialized language. The disambiguation is carried entirely by the capital letter

`the 97% consensus` - A NUMBER MADE BY A DENOMINATOR CHOICE, AND THE PAPER PRINTS BOTH: `66.4% OF ABSTRACTS EXPRESSED NO POSITION on AGW, 32.6% endorsed AGW, 0.7% rejected AGW ... AMONG ABSTRACTS EXPRESSING A POSITION on AGW, 97.1% ENDORSED the consensus position.` The famous figure is computed on the third of the sample that took a position; two thirds are excluded BY DEFINITION, not by data.

`the GO` - THE SAME TWO LETTERS NAME THE WHOLE AND ONE OF ITS THREE PARTS. `The GO KNOWLEDGEBASE CONSISTS OF THREE COMPONENTS: (1) THE GO—a computational knowledge structure ...; (2) GO ANNOTATIONS—...; and (3) GO CAUSAL ACTIVITY MODELS (GO-CAMs)`. **`GO` alone is the ontology; `the GO knowledgebase` is the ontology plus the annotations plus the models**, and both are written `GO` in ordinary prose. A citation saying `according to GO` cannot be resolved to one or the other without reading the sentence around it.

`the hesitant` HERE - ONE OF FIVE MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE POSITIONS, at 20-30%, defined behaviourally as parents who `VACCINATE THEIR CHILD BUT HAVE SIGNIFICANT CONCERNS` and mapped to Gust's `fence-sitter`. A BIN, not a scale
